id:9490: Your cousin-hater cousin was eaten by Blacktalon the Savage in the Great Fissure — kill her and bring back her claws to claim your reward. Turn in the proof to Ikan at the Temple of Telhamat.
id:9398: Scout Vanura wants you to kill 8 Stonescythe Whelps and 4 Stonescythe Alphas in the Great Fissure to protect the Broken from these predators. The rock flayers are preying on displaced survivors, so thin their numbers at the Temple of Telhamat.
id:2: Senani Thunderheart wants the Sharptalon claw as proof of your victory. Bring it to Silverwind Refuge.
id:11: Stormwind wants gnolls near the guard tower and Stone Cairn Lake killed. Collect their painted armbands to prove you handled both packs.
id:16: Gerard, a farmer, wants spring water to stay hydrated. He’ll trade for it—if you have any on hand.
id:23: A night elf-trained bear marked with a quarter-crescent emblem, Ursangous, hunted Horde allies. Take its paw to Tarkan at Silverwind Refuge to remove this enemy weapon.
id:24: Captain Goggath wants the head of the legendary night elf creature Shadumbra to mark the end of the Alliance in Ashenvale. He sees it as a trophy to intimidate and claim victory. You need to bring the head to him at Hellscream’s Watch.
id:25: Tarkan wants you to stop a twisted elemental that’s causing chaos at Silverwind after the mage who summoned it died in battle. The elemental’s out of control, and no one else can handle it.
id:35: The Stormwind soldier thinks the murloc rumors might be true and wants you to check with Guard Thomas at the eastern Elwynn bridge, who knows the area's current state. They offer their charger to speed your trip.
id:37: The quest giver wants to know what happened to Guards Rolf and Malakai, who went to investigate the river and haven’t returned. You need to travel north along the river to find the guards—or what’s left of them—to complete the report.
id:40: Murlocs are attacking eastern Elwynn Forest and scaring off fish. The NPC wants you to convince Marshal Dughan to send troops there, but he’s focused on gnolls and bandits.
id:45: Follow webbed footprints east to a Murloc village near Stone Cairn Lake. Investigate the village to uncover what happened to Rolf.
id:46: Guard Thomas wants you to kill murlocs at Stone Cairn Lake and the forked stream south of Elwynn, collecting 10 torn fins to claim a Stormwind Army bounty. The more you slaughter, the better the reward.
id:47: NPC wants Gold Dust from kobolds for a good price. Find kobolds in Fargodeep Mine (south) and Jasperlode Mine (northeast) to collect it.
id:52: Eastvale Logging Camp is under constant wolf and bear attacks. The animals grow more aggressive the farther from Goldshire, and they need your help to defend the camp.
id:54: The NPC assigns you to help secure Elwynn Forest, then asks you to deliver papers to Goldshire's Marshal Dughan via the southern road outside the border gates. It's a straightforward courier task they're tying to your new duty.
id:59: The NPC gives you a marker to take to Sara Timberlain at Eastvale Logging Camp. She’ll craft armor for you in exchange, which you must then use to defend Elwynn. Eastvale is just east of your current location.
id:60: The NPC needs large kobold candles for their Stormwind apothecary. They want you to collect them from kobolds in Fargodeep Mine or Jasperlode Mine.
id:62: A local reports Kobolds have taken over the Fargodeep Mine south of Goldshire. You need to investigate and confirm the infestation, then return to them for next steps. The mine is between Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
id:71: Guard Thomas needs you to deliver both medallions to the bridge so he can learn what happened to his murdered guards. Head to the bridge and give them to him.
id:76: Someone asks you to scout Jasperlode Mine for kobolds after Fargodeep’s infestation. Head east to Tower of Azora, then north to the mine’s foothills and confirm if kobolds are there.
id:83: The quest-giver wants linen scraps from Elwynn thugs to craft goods for you. Collect the scraps from lawless groups scattered across the forest and return them.
id:84: Someone hands you a pie to deliver to Billy, hoping he chokes on it. Your job is to give the pie as instructed.
id:85: An old widow wants her necklace back and suspects Billy Maclure took it. She says he’s hiding at Maclure Vineyards east of her, and she’ll be grateful once it’s returned.
id:86: Billy wants a Pork Belly Pie from Bernice at the other farm to reveal who has the necklace. He needs you to bring Bernice some tender boar meat and explain it's for the pie.
id:87: A kid claims a big gold-toothed kobold stole an old lady's necklace near Fargodeep Mine and took it to his den above the mine. Find the kobold, take the necklace back.
id:88: The quest-giver wants you to kill the Brackwells' prize pig, Princess, who’s been eating their veggies. Bring her collar from the watermelon patch to claim your reward.
id:106: The girl can’t see her lover Tommy Joe because their families hate each other. She wants you to give him a letter at the river west of Stonefield Farm to express her feelings.
id:107: Deliver a note to William Pestle at Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn. He has a potion to help unite two young lovers, and the note is your request for his aid.
id:111: An NPC asks you to talk to their Gramma, who might know how to help them reconnect with Maybell. She’s inside the house east of your current location.
id:112: Maybell needs an invisibility potion to sneak away to Tommy Joe. Crystal kelp for the recipe is probably in murlocs' hands near Crystal Lake east of Goldshire.
id:114: Deliver invisibility liquor to young Maybell so she can reach Tommy Joe safely. The potion’s duration should help her complete her mission unnoticed.
id:123: A schedule reveals The Collector is receiving gold shipments near Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn. You need to report this intel to Marshal Patterson at Eastvale Logging Camp.
id:147: Quest giver wants you to capture the Collector stealing kingdom gold. He’s hiding at Brackwell Pumpkin Patch—bring him in and retrieve his ring to track his employer.
id:171: An orphan wants you to retrieve a foam sword rack from Craggle Wobbletop in the Canals outside the Trade District to help others enjoy Children's Week. They’re leaving the orphanage after sharing the fun with the kids.
id:172: The orphanage attendant gives you a temporary whistle to meet a child during Children's Week. Use it once to interact with your assigned ward, as it expires after the event. Using it again will dismiss the child.
id:176: Stormwind Army offers a bounty for Hogger, a gnoll in southwest Elwynn Forest who’s escaped all capture attempts. Kill him to claim the reward.
id:182: The NPC in Anvilmar wants you to stop trolls from forming a new, stronger war party that could attack the city while it's focused on troggs. They need you to weaken the trolls now by attacking their groups before they regroup.
id:184: Someone took the Furlbrows' farmland deed, planning to help others forge their own. The Furlbrows left Westfall with a broken wagon and might need the deed back.
id:185: The NPC wants you to track and kill young tigers near the expedition camp to the south, which are easier targets. She learned tiger hunting from her father and wants to test your skills.
id:186: The NPC wants you to hunt fully grown Stranglethorn tigers because they’re stronger than the young ones. Look for them south of Kurzen’s Compound, east of the river. Kill one adult tiger to complete it.
id:187: Ajeck wants proof you’ve defeated the strongest Elder Stranglethorn tigers near the Sundering. Head south to the Cape of Stranglethorn’s border and take down the largest pack.
id:188: The tigress Sin'Dall has killed hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition and is hiding north of Grom'gol. You need to defeat her and bring her paw as proof. No one’s succeeded yet, so be careful—she’s stronger than any other tigers there.
id:190: Hemet Jr.'s group wants you to hunt panthers to prove your skills, starting with younger ones east of here. As you gain experience, you'll take on tougher quarry, eventually returning when you're a master hunter.
id:191: The quest giver notes older panthers are stronger and faster. Follow tracks leading west to hunt them down.
id:192: The NPC says shadowmaws are elusive, older panthers that blend into the dark, making them hard to spot. They want you to prove your hunting skills by tracking these shadowmaws southeast of the river.
id:193: Erlgadin wants you to kill the elusive panther Bhag'thera and bring the Fang as proof of your mastery.
id:194: An NPC challenges you to kill 10 Stranglethorn raptors, testing your ability to find and hunt them without help. They refuse to give location tips, insisting the hunt itself is part of the challenge. Head west to start.
id:195: The quest giver wants you to kill 10 lashtail raptors near Kal'ai Ruins to prove you can handle tougher prey. They’re stronger than previous raptors and found southeast of your location.
id:196: An NPC wants you to hunt Jungle Stalkers in the southern forest across the river. These raptors are harder to track and kill than others, and killing one will give you a story to tell around the fire.
id:197: The dwarf hunter wants you to kill Tethis, a raptor terrorizing Southern Stranglethorn, to prove your skill. Bring back his talon as proof.
id:208: The NPC admires your hunting skills but wants you to prove yourself by killing King Bangalash, the white tiger taunting him south of the jungle. They’ve already taken down three deadly beasts, but Bangalash is the key to his own mission and your final test.
id:216: A Horde NPC wants you to attack the Thistlefur furbolgs west of your location to block an alternative path that could let the Alliance expand. They need the route cut to avoid relying on Astranaar and keep the Horde's advantage. Kill the furbolgs to fulfill your duty and secure the path.
id:218: Soren's ally needs you to kill the trolls and a fire demon in the southeast cave before they force the dwarves out of Coldridge and melt the valley. The trolls are already confused but still a threat, and the fire creature will turn snow into water if left unchecked. Head to the cave and eliminate all three targets.
id:236: [NPC Name] needs you to collect eternal embers from the Cauldron of Flames in Wintergrasp to fuel the Demolishers and Siege Engines. If you run into Horde, fight them and grab their embers too—to keep the advantage.
id:239: The Westbrook Garrison is overwhelmed by gnolls and thieves, and Stormwind has no spare soldiers. Speak to Deputy Rainer there for help—garrison is west past the bridge over the brook.
id:264: The NPC, angry about their spouse’s death in a crusade against the undead, wants you to place a tainted item on his tomb at the Sepulcher, disowning his legacy. They blame the Light’s demands for his absence and death, now rejecting the cursed object he fought to stop.
id:301: Take this report to Prospector Stormpike in Ironforge's Assembly of Explorers—he's angry about Ironband's slow progress. Be ready to duck after delivering it, since his temper's as explosive as his work.
id:309: The NPC needs your help guarding a cart and Miran while transporting powder to Ironband, since the cart's broken and the path is risky with Dark Iron Dwarves involved. They'll feel safer relying on you to protect the shipment until it's delivered.
id:313: A Kharanos leader wants you to find Mountaineer Dunstan's squad at Grizzled Den and deploy gnome observation bots to monitor the trogg threat, then return to Kharanos. The bots will help track the situation without direct confrontation.
id:314: A rancher asks you to kill Vagash, a beast attacking their herd, since Ironforge’s troops can’t help. He’s lurking nearby—slay him and bring back his fang.
id:315: A brewer is trying to make the perfect stout and wants shimmerweed from Frostmane trolls' Shimmer Ridge village. They believe the plant's unique flavor could boost their recipe. Steal the shimmerweed from troll baskets and return for payment.
id:332: Gallina wants you to take a pamphlet to her sister Suzetta’s wine shop in Stormwind’s Trade District for a free bottle of Dalaran Noir. The shop is near the canals, and the reward is a complimentary wine sample.
id:333: Harlan needs a resupply of knitted clothing and asks you to get more from Rema Schneider at the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop because he's running out.
id:334: A parent needs you to deliver a sewing kit to their son Thurman, an apprentice at Larson Clothiers in the Mage's Quarter, so he can finish his work. The shop is near the Mage's Tower, deeper in the district.
id:351: Oglethorpe, a gnomish robot in a metal egg, needs his missing homing robot recovered for a reward. He gives you a beacon to track it down near Gaping Chasm in Tanaris.
id:353: Gringer Stormpike asked someone to make him a weapon. The player needs to deliver the finished weapon to him at the northern guard tower in Loch Modan. It's a favor for the dwarven Mountaineer.
id:384: The tavern keeper needs boar ribs and a Rhapsody Malt from their own tavern to fill orders since their usual supplier joined the army. They’ll trade the family recipe for Beer Basted Boar Ribs and a free sample in return—key ingredient is that special malt.
id:412: A gnomish engineer in Kharanos needs you to retrieve stolen gyromechanic gears from Frostmane scavengers southeast of town to repair steam tanks. They’ve been using the gears for repairs since staying to defend the town from Frostmane attacks.
id:432: The NPC wants you to kill the troggs destroying their work site. They're stressed and angry but can't do it themselves because their aim is bad. You'll get paid for hurting or killing them.
id:433: A Senate member and Explorers' League researcher says troggs have overrun the Gol'Bolar quarry, destroying equipment and trapping miners underground. They need you to deliver enchanted runes to the trapped miners so they can escape safely.
id:475: Gaerolas, a druid warden, hasn't sent his report. He guards hibernating druids in a barrow den, but delays raise concerns. Head to Starbreeze Village to get his update.
id:476: Gnarlpines, led by corrupted Ursal the Mauler, attacked Starbreeze Village using fel moss to spread madness. The wounded survivor needs you to warn Athridas before the tribe reaches Ban'ethil Barrow Den.
id:483: A druid asks you to collect four relics from the Ban'ethil Barrow Den—Raven Claw Talisman, Black Feather Quill, Sapphire of Sky, and Rune of Nesting—to break the Emerald Dream hibernation before Gnarlpine invaders finish corrupting it. The relics are stored in sacred chests; return them to complete the awakening ritual.
id:485: Oglethorpe Obnoticus, a gnomish robot trapped in an egg-shaped device, asks you to recover his crashed homing robot. He offers a beacon to locate it at Skulk Rock, near the head of a river, in exchange for your help.
id:486: The quest giver wants to free the Druids of the Talon by killing Ursal the Mauler, who cursed them. They’ll use relics to perform a ritual, but Ursal must die first. Head to The Cleft northwest then north to fight him.
id:487: A Darnassus guard wants you to kill corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs ambushing the road. They’re blocking trade and travelers, so smash their northern-path den and report back.
id:488: Zenn wants you to gather nightsaber fangs, strigid owl feathers, and webwood spider silk for his business. He promises rewards in exchange, but insists it’s a secret.
id:489: The Council of the Forest demands redemption for helping enemy satyr Zenn Foulhoof to remain a friend of Teldrassil. Trick him by giving Fel Cones—corrupted seeds—as a snack.
id:543: An NPC wants the Perenolde Tiara, an Alterac heirloom crafted in Ironforge, which an Ogre Mage named Grel'borg the Miser is hoarding in the Ruins of Alterac. You need to retrieve it for them.
id:583: The dwarf in the camp is Hemet Nesingwary’s son and a tough Alliance hunter. Even though he’s not friendly, you should talk to him to get some useful hunting advice.
id:648: Oglethorpe Obnoticus needs you to escort OOX-17/TN to a safe spot near the Caverns of Time so it can prepare to take off. Once that’s done, talk to him again in Booty Bay.
id:743: Ruul wants you to face the Windfury harpies to the southeast as a test of your strength and readiness to adventure beyond Mulgore. The harpies are enemies of the region and will challenge your combat skills.
id:746: Quest giver wants you to stop dwarves from defiling the land with their dig. Collect their digging tools, smash them at any forge (even their camp has one), and return the broken tools to prove it’s done.
id:749: Your attackers destroyed a Venture Co. caravan near Stonebull Lake but left their crates, thinking fire would destroy valuables. Now Venture salvagers are looting the site, so they want you to check the crates for something they missed.
id:751: Venture Co. mining in Mulgore was attacked—caravan supplies are scattered, and a fire burns in the eastern foothills where workers are active. Head east to investigate the smoke and sounds.
id:761: Collect Swoop Quills from Mulgore to prove your hunting skill. The rare birds are hard to spot and catch, so keep your eyes sharp and move quickly. Turn in their quills as proof.
id:764: A Tauren ally wants you to stop Venture Co. goblins from over-expanding in their lands. Head northeast of the ravaged caravan to their mine and destroy their operations. The goblins' greedy growth can't be allowed to continue.
id:765: The NPC wants you to kill Supervisor Fizsprocket at the Venture Co. mine east of the destroyed caravan to retrieve his clipboard, which might reveal more about their plans to take over the area.
id:768: A Thunder Bluff leatherworker wants you to hunt beasts and bring their skins to craft armor. They’ll make gear for you in exchange, so collect as many hides as needed and return.
id:769: A leatherworker in Mulgore wants you to bring trade supplies so they can teach you to craft a Kodo Hide Bag. They’ll share the knowledge in exchange for the materials needed for their trade.
id:770: An NPC at Camp Sungraze wants you to report Ghost Howl's death, noting its wound from Burning Legion battles, to share this info with the camp. The player must relay Ghost Howl's demise to someone in Camp Sungraze.
id:773: After passing the Rite of Vision and drinking the Water of Seers, travel east of Thunder Bluff to Red Rocks and seek the Ancestral Spirit {name} to gain the blessing of ancestors.
id:824: Take the globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost—he’s an Earthen Ring shaman who can identify its significance. The quest involves consulting him for lore-related insight.
id:833: The NPC asks you to drive a band of Bristleback Interlopers from Red Rocks, a sacred tauren burial site they’re desecrating. They’re too old to fight, and the graves are sacred to those who died defending Thunder Bluff. You need to force the interlopers off the land to honor the fallen.
id:834: Rezlak, a Gazlowe associate, needs supplies stolen by Dustwind harpies in Razorwind Canyon. Search the canyon’s southern ravine to retrieve them.
id:835: The NPC wants to stop harpies attacking supply caravans by killing them in the eastern canyon. They offer a deal to help secure the routes.
id:836: Oglethorpe Obnoticus needs you to move the robot OOX-09/HL to big rocks to activate its cloaking device. Get it there safely, then talk to him in Booty Bay afterward.
id:840: An NPC says a friend named Kargal needs recruits for the Horde and asks the player to deliver a letter to him. The player’s task is to take the letter to Kargal so he can sign it.
id:844: An NPC frustrated with plainstriders blocking caravans wants you to kill them and bring their beaks to prove the roads are clear. They suspect quilboar might be using the birds to bait ambushes.
id:845: A horde ally wants you to hunt zhevra north and south, collecting hooves to prove your strength. They’ll send you after tougher targets if you succeed.
id:848: Apothecaries from Lordaeron want spores from a mushroom near Forgotten Pools in the Barrens. They believe the spores have useful properties for their work. The mushroom grows in an area where oasis energy alters local life.
id:850: A tauren leader wants you to kill Barak Kodobane, the centaur rallying Kolkar forces in the Barrens. He’s threatening tauren holdings, so defeat him west of the Forgotten Pools and return his head.
id:851: Kill Wyneth in Verog's command tent west of your location to lure him out. Verog will attack when his mate is killed, letting you disrupt the centaur leadership as ordered by Regthar.
id:852: An NPC wants you to kill Hezrul Bloodmark, leader of the Kolkar centaurs at Lushwater Oasis to the south, to weaken their threat. Bring his head back to the outpost as proof.
id:855: A Horde agent wants you to weaken centaur leaders by killing Kolkar Marauders and Stormseers at Lushwater Oasis to the south. Collect their bracers as proof, then return for a reward. The goal is to disrupt centaur discipline by targeting key warriors.
id:858: Sputtervalve is stuck because he needs a key to unlock the shredder's movement column. He lied about a mechanical issue and needs you to get the key from Supervisor Lugwizzle on the upper level so they can leave quickly.
id:863: The NPC wants to escape by figuring out some buttons and a lever. They’re asking if you’re ready to help them move forward.
id:865: Coleasterus wants the horn of King Reaperclaw, the smartest raptor in the Barrens. He believes the raptor’s intelligence is in its horn, which he can use to make a profitable smart drink. You need to retrieve it from the bluffs north of Ratchet.
id:866: An NPC in the Barrens asks herbalists to collect root samples from local herbs, which are subtly changed by oasis water. They want to compare these altered roots to herbs from other regions to study their unique properties. Players need to gather and return the samples to help with the research.
id:869: Raptor tracks lead northeast from the wreckage toward Thorn Hill. They’re shallow with no rider footprints, hinting at something unnatural. Follow them to solve the mystery.
id:870: A druid senses a power leak beneath the Forgotten Pools northwest of Crossroads, linked to the Barrens disaster. They want you to investigate the pools and return with answers.
id:871: Razormane tribe quilboars are attacking supply caravans from Orgrimmar. Kill them near the river south of Far Watch to help defend the caravans until scouts locate the leader.
id:872: The NPC is fed up with Pigmen raiding Durotar’s border and wants them crushed. The player must find a quilboar-infested cavern south of the stables and defeat Kreenig Snarlsnout to stop the attacks.
id:875: An NPC wants you to kill the Witchwing Slayers in the Dry Hills to break the harpy raiders' leadership. They’re pushing back against the Horde, and making an example of the Slayers is key.
id:876: An ally wants you to kill Serena Bloodfeather, the harpies' matron, to end her grudge against the Horde. The harpies’ hatred points to her as their leader—take her out to resolve the conflict.
id:877: Tonga wants you to take dead seeds to the Stagnant Oasis and test if a fissure there is causing stagnation like the Forgotten Pools. Place the seeds in the fissure if it exists, then report results back to Tonga.
id:880: Jerrik says snapjaw turtles at the Stagnant Oasis have become aggressive and multiplied, probably due to the oases' energy. He wants you to collect their shells and take them to Tonga in Crossroads for study.
id:881: The tauren call Whitemist Echeyakee, a cat said to be both mercy and death. Your guide tells you to find and hunt him northwest of your location, near giant Kodo bones, and blow the horn you’re given to summon him. His stealth is legendary, so the horn ensures he’ll appear when you’re ready to fight.
id:887: Gazlowe's employee needs a promotion by solving Ratchet's pirate problem—new buccaneers seized Fray Island and attacked their ships. They want you to go there and eliminate the pirates to prove results.
id:891: The Captain wants revenge on Theramore humans for sinking their ships. Head south to the Merchant Coast, destroy their camp, and bring back marines' medals while killing Lieutenants Pyre and Buckland.
id:895: Gazlowe wants Cap'n Garvey dead for crimes like piracy and slavery. He recently attacked Fray Island with Southsea Freebooters. Bring back proof of his death that's recognizable.
id:899: This NPC’s wife was killed and his home destroyed by pig men. He’s hunted them nonstop since then and wants you to kill more, bringing their tusks to help him keep his revenge crusade going.
id:903: The NPC wants you to track down Barrens huntresses sabotaging their scouts, especially near the town’s northeast edge. They’re deadly and quick, and careless players could end up getting hunted.
id:918: The speaker wants to help calm the angry timberlings by testing new plant-nurturing methods. They need you to gather seeds from timberlings around Lake Al'Ameth to use in their research.
id:919: The NPC wants you to remove timberling sprouts from Lake Al'Ameth—they can’t be saved and will become a problem if they grow. Take all you find while exploring the lake.
id:922: Take a seed to druid Rellian Greenspyre at Wellspring Hovel—he wants to experiment with Timberling specimens. Find his hovel west of Dolanaar on the Darnassus road.
id:923: An NPC wants you to kill the corrupted timberlings around Wellspring Lake and collect their mossy tumors. Bring the tumors back to burn them, stopping the corruption threatening Teldrassil.
id:927: An NPC wants you to retrieve the still-beating moss-covered heart of Blackmoss the Fetid for Denalan. The heart’s dark, oily moss hides its shape, but it pulses rhythmically. Denalan likely needs it for study or use.
id:929: An NPC tells you druids in Darnassus need their moonwell replenished with water collected from the moonwell outside Starbreeze Village. Take a phial to fill it there and return to them.
id:930: Find the glowing fruit hanging from the plant's fronds and return it to Denalan. He needs to study it.
id:932: The NPC warns you to keep this secret: Lord Melenas, a dangerous satyr, is holed up in a cave north of Fel Rock with grell warriors. He’s plotting something sinister, and they need you to kill him and return his head—discreetly.
id:933: Head south to the Pools of Arlithrien and collect water from the last moonwell. An ally there needs it to fight the spreading corruption.
id:935: An NPC says the water isn’t for them and needs to be returned to Corithras at the crossroads. The player must deliver it to him so it can reach its actual destination.
id:937: A Sentinel needs help defending the Oracle Tree from harpies. Kill the harpies and return their belts to stop them from attacking messengers like the one who was killed.
id:938: A wounded gray sabercat with deep injuries signals intelligence in her blue eyes and seems to want to follow you, hinting she needs help.
id:941: The NPC has removed moss from the heart, but it remains tainted. They want you to place it in their planter filled with soil that might cleanse it.
id:976: Delgren needs supplies and messages delivered to Sentinel Starbreeze in Auberdine but is worried about enemies in the forest. They want the player to guard them on the trip to ensure the supplies reach safely.
id:996: A corrupted windblossom has rotten, poisonous berries. Restore it to normal.
id:997: An NPC in Dolanaar asks you to deliver a package of rare earths to Denalan, who studies Teldrassil's plant life at his camp east of Lake Al'Ameth. The package just arrived and needs to be taken to him.
id:998: A corrupted windblossom plant has rotten, poisonous berries. You need to restore it to its normal state. The plant desperately needs attention to be fixed.
id:1036: A Bloodsail Buccaneer tells you Fleet Master Firallon needs help on the Crimson Veil. Head to the ship east of Booty Bay and speak to him below decks. They’re looking for strong crewmates for a mission.
id:1097: Grimand Elmore, a dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind, needs help delivering a package to his homeland. He’s in the Dwarven District at his weapon shop. Talk to him to take on the task.
id:1133: Go to Astranaar and talk to Shindrell Swiftfire to offer your services. Don’t mention who sent you—she doesn’t know them.
id:1168: An ogre begs you to help fight the Black Dragon army, seeking revenge for their slain kin and a way home after Mok'Morokk abandoned them. Mok'Morokk prioritized power over ogres, leading them to a battle they can’t win alone.
id:1201: The Horde wants you to eliminate Alliance spies east of Brackenwall Village, who’re secretly reporting movements to Theramore. Kill them to cut off their intel and send a warning to their commanders.
id:1202: A spy failed to steal documents from a Theramore dock ship and had to abandon them in the water. The NPC wants you to recover the footlocker holding the documents from under the docks and bring them back.
id:1204: The quest giver is making *Mudrock Soup and Bugs* and needs you to collect forked Mudrock Turtletongues from Dustwallow Marsh’s coast and bay. They claim the forked tongues have a distinct flavor only found in certain turtles.
id:1205: An ancient crocolisk named Deadmire is suffering in the Dustwallow Marsh. The NPC wants you to kill it to end its torment and grant it peace.
id:1222: Stinky needs a fight to escape creatures while he searches for bogbean leaves for cook Morgan Stern's recipe. He's stuck in the area and wants the player to watch his back during the search.
id:1258: The quest giver wants pristine shelled legs from adult spiny rock crawler crabs in Dustwallow to test a recipe. They need a lot since each crab only has one or two usable legs. Head to the rocks near Theramore to gather them.
id:1270: Stinky needs help escaping the swamp and finding bogbean leaves for a goblin named Mebok, who's paying them to retrieve the plant. They’re surrounded by critters and rely on the player to clear a path and protect them during the search.
id:1442: Stilwell, a blacksmith from long ago, wants a Kor gem for noble purposes. Go to Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale and retrieve one from naga holding ancient ruins. The speaker warns not to go alone.
id:1453: An NPC sends you to Desolace to meet Kreldig Ungor for a job, but warns it’s dangerous due to centaurs and other threats. Find him at Nijel’s Point, a hidden camp in northern Desolace east of Stonetalon Mountains.
id:1454: Karnitol, a Stormwind noble, had his ship attacked by sea giants near northwest Desolace and left behind a valuable chest to escape. He wants the player to retrieve the chest and return it to him in Stormwind.
id:1455: The chest was torn open by non-human claws and is empty. Kreldig wanted its contents and will be disappointed. Report back with what you found.
id:1456: An NPC suggests searching for Karnitol's belongings at night elf ruins near Ranazjar Isle, where the Slitherblade naga live. They think the powerful tidehunters or sea witches there might have what you need.
id:1467: The NPC wants you to go to Ironforge and talk to Roetten to get paid, mentioning Leftwitch's package as a priority. They’ll recommend you once they return to Desolace.
id:1468: The orphanage staff needs your help during Children's Week. Take the whistle to call your assigned ward—use it to meet them and again to dismiss them. It only works for a short time, so focus on what they need.
id:1514: A corrupted windblossom plant is sick and poisonous. Someone needs to help restore it to its normal state.
id:1578: Thorvald, a colleague, is helping the mountaineers in Loch Modan by supplying them with gear. He needs you to bring copper axes and copper chain belts to the southern guard tower to support the fight against the troggs.
id:1581: The Bladeleaf wife needs pre-made elixirs because her husband’s too busy mixing potions. Bring them to her and she’ll trade rare herbs.
id:1582: A Darnassus leatherworker needs help fulfilling orders for adventurers' supplies. Help craft leather goods to learn an advanced leatherworking technique. The Moonglow Vest is key to proving your skill.
id:1618: A dwarf says Redridge's humans are short on gear from blackrock orc attacks. They need help helping their blacksmith, Verner Osgood, who’ll teach the player some tricks in return.
id:1655: Bailor is worried about a stolen ore shipment meant for Ironforge. Ogres ambushed the caravan from the Wetlands, and the surviving guard recently died. He thinks the shipment is northeast across the Loch.
id:1918: A slain elemental’s glowing water globe holds the pollutant from Mystral Lake. Take it to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, who might know who wants this tainted sample.
id:2039: NPC says Bingles hasn't reported back from a Gnomeregan mission for a week and might be in trouble. They think he was last seen flying over Loch and ask you to investigate.
id:2158: A friend of Innkeeper Farley recommends staying at the Lion’s Pride Inn for rest. Tell Farley you were sent by them to get
id:2159: A non-player character needs herbs delivered to Dolanaar but can’t leave due to druid business. Take the package to Innkeeper Keldamyr at the Dolanaar inn, south along the road.
id:2206: The Dockmaster wants you to steal a shipping schedule from bandits using Jerod’s Landing to smuggle goods between Redridge and Westfall. Infiltrate the dock house, grab the schedule from their hideout, and avoid getting caught—SI:7 won’t protect you if you’re discovered.
id:2278: A stone watcher appears after you touch four platinum discs, claiming they hold the Creators' recorded history of shaping the Earthen. The discs’ sigils and the watcher’s message unlock new lore about Azeroth’s origins.
id:2280: The Discs of Norgannon react again, producing a grinding noise and dropping a miniature version into your pack. Someone studying Azeroth’s ancient history badly needs these mini-discs. Take them to the next quest NPC.
id:2438: A druid gave them an emerald dreamcatcher that grants luck by siphoning the Emerald Dream. Starbreeze Village, where it’s stored, is now overrun by corrupted furbolg. They need you to retrieve it.
id:2459: Starbreeze's quest-giver says Ferocitas the Dream Eater stole their emerald. He’s leading corrupted Gnarlpine mystics north of town, wearing the glowing stolen jewel. Retrieve the emerald and fight off some of the mystics.
id:2499: The NPC says Oakenscowl, a tree near their old cave now in a nook northeast, is infected with a massive tumor spreading corruption. They want you to find Oakenscowl and collect the tumor to stop the contamination.
id:2518: Lady Sathrah, a mad spider once blessed by Elune, needs to be found northeast of the river to end her suffering and save her future generations. Bring back her silvery spinnerets to stop her madness.
id:2541: A Gnarlpine shaman is trapped in the Emerald Dream while furbolg use their animated body to attack Ban'ethil Barrow Den. They need you to bring a charm used in their spirit-separation ritual to stop it.
id:2561: An NPC wants you to kill their soulless body in a nearby chamber and use a voodoo charm on it to free them from the Gnarlpine’s control. Return afterward.
id:2751: Orokk, a clan leader without heirs, wants you to collect two patterned bronze bracers, two bronze greatswords, and two sharp claws to preserve his family's crafting legacy. He’ll continue the Omosh tradition if you prove your worth by gathering these items.
id:2752: Orokk wants you to forge four bronze battleaxes and four bronze warhammers at the anvil. After completing the order, you’ll learn about the iron pauldron.
id:2753: Orokk wants four green iron helms, four bracers, and two leggings to teach two more lessons. Bring them so you can learn and weaken enemies.
id:2754: Orokk wants you to retrieve two iron mauls, two silvered bronze boots, and two silvered bronze gauntlets from the sacred anvil and forge as part of their final lesson. They’re using the items to instill fear in others, so speed and precision matter.
id:2755: Orokk wants to teach you the final Omosh family moves before dying happy. Learn the Omosh dance of joy first, then the fist of iron.
id:2878: A corrupted songflower emitting a pungent odor needs your help to restore it to health.
id:2945: You found a dirty ring from a Dark Iron dwarf corpse. It’s covered in hardened grime but might be valuable once cleaned. Find a way to remove the residue to unlock its use.
id:2947: An Ironforge-crafted ring with the initials "TdK" reacts with magic when you wear it. You can keep it or return it to the owner or maker to see what happens.
id:2948: The Gnome wants to upgrade your ring with a silver and agate lattice for a better design. They need a silver bar, a moss agate, and a few extra coins since their materials are low. Bring those to complete the upgrade.
id:2949: A box from the Sparklematic 5200 gives you a magic ring with the Orgrimmar seal and the partial name "NOG." The ring might belong to or be made by someone with those initials. You need to track down the person identified by "NOG."
id:2950: Nogg denies owning the ring but will upgrade it for the player using a silver bar, moss agate, and 30 silver coins to boost its magic, as a favor for their earlier help with the Dark Irons.
id:2951: A gnome created the Sparklematic 5200 to clean and restore shiny items. It requires inserting the item and three silver coins. The player needs to use it to get their valuable items cleaned and working properly.
id:2953: The Sparklematic 5200 needs a grime-covered item and 3 silver coins to clean it. Bring the object and pay 3 silver to use the machine.
id:3064: The shopkeeper needs you to collect multiple pirate hats. They want to stock their shop.
id:3361: A lost gnome refugee says an earthquake threw him off course and trolls stole his gear. He asks you to infiltrate southwest troll camps and return his stolen belongings to escape the wilderness.
id:3861: A chicken scratches "Salden" into the dirt, then walks off. You need to figure out why it’s pointing you toward that name.
id:4021: A Kolkar force from Desolace is invading the Barrens to seek revenge. Kill their troops until leader Warlord Krom'zar appears, defeat him, and return a piece of his banner as proof.
id:4083: A spectral chalice floats, pulsing faintly with a dying heart's rhythm. It’s the last trace of something recently killed—find it and bring it to the spirit clinging to its echo.
id:4103: Cenarion Circle member wants you to collect corrupted soul shards from tainted beasts they’ve put down, so they can make salve to heal corrupted plants. They’ll trade prepared salve for the shards you gather.
id:4104: An NPC explains that using a Cenarion beacon while mining in Felwood reveals tainted vitriol in metal veins. They can purify it into a reagent for Cenarion plant salve, which the player must then apply to wild plants in need of healing. If the player already has tainted vitriol, the NPC will give them pre-made salve instead.
id:4105: Herbalist asks player to gather herbs in Felwood using a Cenarion beacon, which reveals hidden fel creep. They’ll trade the pre-made salve for whatever the player collects. The beacon is required to spot the threat—player just needs to bring back the gathered materials.
id:4106: The NPC needs you to collect tainted skin patches from Felwood kills using a Cenarion beacon. They’ll trade pre-made plant salves for the patches you gather. Bring the tainted skins back to them once you’ve got them.
id:4107: Bring a lesser eternal essence from disenchanting any suitable item to trade for Cenarion plant salves. No Cenarion beacon needed—any item yielding the essence works.
id:4108: The NPC wants corrupted soul shards from tainted beasts you kill to make plant salve. Trade shards for pre-made salves to heal corrupted plants.
id:4109: An NPC teaches you to purify tainted vitriol found in Felwood's raw metal veins using a Cenarion beacon, turning it into salve to save corrupted plants. They’ll give you pre-made salve if you’ve already gathered the vitriol.
id:4110: The herbalist asks you to gather fel creep in Felwood using the Cenarion beacon. They’ll trade the pre-made salve for what you collect.
id:4111: An NPC wants you to collect tainted skin patches from your skinned kills in Felwood using a Cenarion beacon. They’ll trade you plant salves in exchange for the patches you bring them. Make sure to have the beacon active while skinning.
id:4112: The NPC wants a single lesser eternal essence from a disenchanted magical item to make Cenarion plant salves, offering salves in exchange. Any item that yields the essence works—no Cenarion beacon needed. The essence is potent, so one is enough.
id:4113: The corrupted songflower emits a foul odor and needs immediate attention to be restored to normal. You must heal it before it's too late.
id:4114: The corrupted songflower has a foul smell and needs healing. Restore its health to turn it back to normal.
id:4115: A corrupted windblossom is sick and producing toxic berries. You need to heal it to restore it to its normal state.
id:4116: An NPC tells you a corrupted songflower has a foul odor and needs healing. You must restore it to its original state.
id:4117: An NPC wants you to heal a corrupted whipper root covered in slime to restore it to normal. The plant’s tough, leathery roots are diseased and need treatment.
id:4118: An NPC found a corrupted songflower emitting a foul smell and needs it restored to normal. The plant is sickly and requires immediate attention to reverse its corruption.
id:4119: A corrupted night dragon plant is producing poisonous fruits. Someone needs to find a way to restore it before it spreads further.
id:4221: Someone found a corrupted windblossom with rotten berries and needs to heal it to restore it to normal.
id:4222: An NPC identifies a corrupted windblossom plant with poisonous berries. They need you to restore it to normal. The plant requires immediate attention to reverse the corruption.
id:4295: An inebriated NPC begs you to get them Dark Iron ale to stay drunk, because sobriety blurs their vision and makes them see you as a {race} they killed last week. They’ll likely hostile if you don’t act fast.
id:4343: An NPC wants you to restore a corrupted windblossom plant with rotten berries. The plant needs immediate attention to return to normal.
id:4401: A corrupted songflower needs purifying to restore it to normal. The plant is sickly and emits a bad odor, so you’ll need to treat it to reverse the corruption.
id:4403: A corrupted windblossom with rotten berries needs restoration. Fix it to return it to normal.
id:4443: This corrupted whipper root is infected and needs healing to return to normal. The goal is to figure out what’s wrong with it and find a way to fix it.
id:4444: A corrupted whipper root has tough, slimy roots and needs restoration. Help return it to its normal state.
id:4445: A corrupted whipper root is sick and needs healing to return to normal. Its slimy, leathery roots are a sign of decay—figure out how to treat it before it’s beyond saving.
id:4446: A corrupted whipper root needs help restoring it to health. The plant has tough, sludgy roots coated in slime and is clearly suffering from a sickness. You’re expected to figure out how to heal it or return it to normal.
id:4447: A corrupted night dragon plant with rotten, poisonous fruits needs help restoring it to normal. Its sickness requires immediate action to prevent further decay.
id:4448: The corrupted night dragon plant has poisonous, rotten fruits and needs healing. Restore it to its normal state.
id:4461: A corrupted whipper root is covered in slime and toughened roots—needs fixing to return to normal. Someone wants it restored, probably with some kind of treatment or care.
id:4462: A corrupted night dragon plant with rotten fruits needs restoration. Find a way to heal it to return it to normal.
id:4463: A mysterious figure wants you to present the components for a task and pay 30 gold pieces as part of the deal.
id:4464: A corrupted songflower is emitting a foul odor and needs restoration to return to normal. It desperately requires attention to revert to its healthy state.
id:4466: A corrupted windblossom plant with rotten, poisonous berries needs restoring to normal. Someone wants it fixed—probably by purifying or removing the corruption. The plant’s clearly sick and requires immediate action to save it.
id:4467: This corrupted windblossom is diseased and poisonous. Someone needs to help purify it before it spreads. Talk to an expert to learn how to fix it.
id:4481: NPC sells the Libram of Constitution for 30 gold, keeping the components you gathered but giving you the trinket in return. You need to pay the price to claim your reward.
id:4482: The NPC wants thirty gold and specific components from you to get the Libram of Tenacity. They’re selling it, so you’ll need to pay the cost and bring what they require.
id:4483: An NPC sells the Libram of Resilience for 30 gold. They demand payment upfront. The player must pay to obtain the resilience item.
id:4484: An NPC wants 30 gold and components for the Libram of Voracity. Give them to finish the quest.
id:4512: The slime researcher wants samples from Felwood oozes to study their origins. They’ll give you containers to collect slime from dead creatures there.
id:4513: Laris needs pure slime samples that aren’t polluted like Felwood’s corrupt ones, probably to study their natural form. They give you containers to collect unpolluted samples yourself.
id:4601: A gnome built a cleaning device called the Sparklematic 5200. It cleans shiny items for three silver coins each. The player needs to use it to restore sparkles, likely helping the gnome's efforts.
id:4602: A gnome's Sparklematic 5200 cleans sparklies by inserting items and three silver coins. Use it to return shine to valuables.
id:4603: The Sparklematic 5200 needs a grime-encrusted object and three silver coins to start cleaning it. Use the machine with the right items to complete the task.
id:4604: Find a grime-encrusted object and three silver coins to use the Sparklematic 5200. Insert them to start the cleaning process.
id:4621: A Bloodsail Buccanee wants you to kill Booty Bay's Fleet Master Seahorn and Baron Revilgaz to remove their control and legal threats. They’ll grant you honorary admiral status if you do it, freeing Bloodsail ships from Booty Bay’s reach.
id:5041: The Crossroads supplier needs stolen supplies back—quilsboar took them. Search their hovel south of the river and return the crates.
id:5421: The pirate in Shadowprey Village wants you to collect shellfish from their traps below the docks. They're too lazy to do it themselves and will reward you for completing the task.
id:5501: Bone Collector wants you to collect 10 kodo bones from the graveyard south of your location and deliver them to Shadowprey Village via caravan. They’ll reward you for the shipment, which supplies materials for artisans and alchemists.
id:5502: The orphan asks you to find Blax Bottlerocket in the Drag, who’s still pushing his cart, to get a foam sword rack so other orphans can have fun too. They’re grateful for your help and want to share the Children’s Week joy with their friends.
id:5545: The quest giver needs you to collect eight chopped wood bundles north of here—wolves and bears drove their workers away. Deputy Rainer is handling the animals, but you must retrieve the wood to meet their deadline.
id:5561: Bibbly and his caravan partners need you to use their kodo kombobulator to tame ancient or aged kodos. Jolt the beasts into following you, then return them tamed to complete the job.
id:5581: NPC gives you the Hand of Iruxos to banish demon portals at Mannoroc Coven, stopping demons from invading the world. They got the artifact from a Burning Blade leader to help turn the tide against the growing demon threat.
id:5713: NPC is poisoned by furbolg Marosh's attack and needs protection while making an antidote. After surviving, they’ll deliver a message to Lor’danel while the player reports the incident to Onaeya at Maestra’s Post. Defend them until the antidote is ready.
id:5741: An NPC warns that the Burning Blade in Thunder Axe Fortress has the powerful Sceptre of Light, which can sink cities. They want you to steal it from a seer in one of their watchtowers to stop the group from using it.
id:5805: Turn in a Collector's Edition voucher to Merissa Stilwell in Goldshire to claim a free companion reward. The voucher is a one-time gift for purchasing the special edition. Just speak to her to receive your companion.
id:5821: Rigger needs a bodyguard to lead a kodo past the Kolkar Centaur village. If you keep the caravan safe, you can collect your reward from Smeed Scrabblescrew, who works with them. The main goal is to make sure the group gets through without being attacked.
id:5841: Turn in the voucher to Yori Crackhelm in Kharanos to claim your Collector's Edition gift: a companion for your journey.
id:5842: Turn in the voucher to Orenthil Whisperwind in Dolanaar for a companion reward. The NPC wants to give you a gift for buying the Collector's Edition, so speak to them to claim it.
id:5843: Turn in this voucher to Magga in Razor Hill as a Collector's Edition reward. She’ll give you a companion to join you on your adventure.
id:5844: Turn in this voucher to Vorn Skyseer in Bloodhoof Village to get a free companion. Vorn is thanking you for buying the Collector's Edition.
id:5847: Turn in this voucher to Claire Willower in Brill as a Collector's Edition bonus. You'll receive a companion to help you on your adventures.
id:5882: This NPC uses a Cenarion beacon to spot corrupted soul shards in tainted beasts. They need the shards to make salve for healing plants and will give you prepared salves in exchange for the shards you collect.
id:5883: Gather tainted vitriol while mining in Felwood using a Cenarion beacon. Purify it to make salve to treat corrupted plants. If you already have some, you can trade it for pre-made salve.
id:5884: A Cenarion herbalist wants you to gather herbs in Felwood with their beacon to collect fel creep, which you’ll trade for pre-made plant salve. The beacon makes the corruption visible while gathering, letting you harvest it alongside regular herbs. They’ll swap what you bring for ready-to-use salve.
id:5885: An NPC needs tainted skin patches from Felwood kills, found using a Cenarion beacon, to trade for pre-made Cenarion plant salves. You collect the patches and return them for the salves.
id:5886: The NPC wants a single lesser eternal essence from disenchanting magical items to make Cenarion plant salve. They’ll trade salves in return. Any disenchanted item that drops the essence works.
id:5887: Bring corrupted soul shards from tamed beasts to this Cenarion researcher. They'll trade those shards for plant salve used to heal corrupted flora. The salve is made from ground shards they can't produce themselves.
id:5888: An NPC offers to teach you to purify tainted vitriol found in Felwood's mines (using a Cenarion beacon) into plant salve, which you’ll apply to rescue wild plants. If you already have tainted vitriol, they’ll give you pre-made salve instead.
id:5889: The herbalist wants you to gather herbs in Felwood with the Cenarion beacon to spot fel creep. Bring them back to get Cenarion plant salve in exchange. The beacon helps track the creep while collecting herbs.
id:5890: Use a Cenarion beacon while skinning Felwood kills to collect tainted skin patches. Bring the patches to this alchemist to get pre-made Cenarion plant salves in return.
id:5891: The NPC wants a single lesser eternal essence from a disenchanted magical item to make Cenarion plant salve. They’ll trade salves in exchange, no Cenarion beacon needed—just any item that drops the essence.
id:5892: A Dun Baldar NPC needs supplies stored in the Irondeep mine but can't access them now due to Horde fighting. They want you to go retrieve a load of supplies from the mine.
id:5893: NPC needs you to retrieve Coldtooth Mine supplies because it’s often under Alliance or creature control due to scarce defenses. Watch for enemies; the mine’s control shifts quickly.
id:5943: Cork and the Gizelton Caravan need protection past the dangerous Mannoroc Coven, which has the kodos spooked. Succeed to collect payment from Smeed at Scrabblescrew’s Camp.
id:6027: Place the Gem of the Serpent on the Serpent Statue on Ranazjar Isle to summon its protector. Retrieve the Book of the Ancients from the statue to learn about the naga.
id:6031: An NPC in Timbermaw wants you to bring runecloth so they can make more runecloth clothing. They’re motivated because runecloth is rare there but highly valued. They’ll trade something in return if you provide enough.
id:6032: The Timbermaw NPC wants mooncloth, which is sacred to them, not runecloth. Bring a small amount to learn their secret crafting technique.
id:6132: The NPC is trapped in the Valley of Spears, fearing the Marauders might eat them. They need rescue to avoid being cooked by centaurs, with payment from their brother Hornizz at the kodo graveyard camp to the east.
id:6134: Place a ghost magnet between the two big skeletons in the Valley of Bones to attract ghosts. Kill the gathered ghosts, collect their ghost-o-plasm, and return it to the Magram for profit.
id:6321: Executor Zygand wants more Deathguard weapons for Brill due to Scourge threats. Take a requisition order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity, but first talk to Bat Handler Anette about transport.
id:6322: Talk to Undercity bat master Michael Garrett to get a bat for Brill. He’s providing transportation after supplies were already delivered.
id:6323: The NPC offers a free bat ride to the Undercity, no cost. Player must meet Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter there.Tell the player they’re arranging transport via bat.
id:6324: Morris in Brill can give you a bat to ride back to him after you've met Bat Handler Anette. Bats only fly to the Undercity unless you’ve visited another bat master first. Since you’ve met Anette, you can now ride bats to Brill. Talk to Morris again when you're ready.
id:6341: An NPC in Dolanaar offers to send a gift to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus. Talk to them again to hire a hippogryph for a small fee and find Sister Aquinne south of the hippogryph master.
id:6342: The NPC at the Temple of the Moon wants you to deliver a thank-you note to Nyoma in Dolanaar because the gift reminded them of home. Hire Leora’s hippogryph to return to Dolanaar and hand over the note.
id:6343: The NPC arranges a hippogryph ride back to Dolanaar through Fidelio, who already knows you. They want you to remember to talk to flight masters in new towns to set up travel routes. Your task is to return to Dolanaar by flying with them.
id:6344: A Dolanaar friend of yours, Sister Aquinne, is training as a Darnassus priestess and misses home. They want you to deliver a recipe book to her in the city—rent a hippogryph from Fidelio near the town center to get there.
id:6361: Take the Mulgan hides to Thunder Bluff for the NPC so a colleague named Ahanu can make leather goods. Talk to Tak in Bloodhoof Village about wind rider transport to get there.
id:6362: Quest giver offers a paid wind rider ride to Thunder Bluff, the fastest option. They hint Ahanu might be at Hewa's Armory there, near the landing spot. Player must return to accept the ride.
id:6363: Take leather goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff to arrange transport to Bloodhoof Village. If you’ve already been to Bloodhoof, use a wind rider to return.
id:6364: Tak offers a wind rider flight to Bloodhoof Village for a fee, since you've already been there. You'll need to deliver leather goods to Varg Windwhisper once you arrive. Speak to Tak when ready to book the ride.
id:6365: Deliver meat to Gryshka, the Orgrimmar innkeeper. Use a wind rider arranged with Burok in Razor Hill for transport.
id:6384: The NPC offers a wind rider to Orgrimmar for a few coins. Once there, deliver Grimtak's meats to Gryshka at her inn in the Valley of Strength.
id:6385: Take the letter to Doras in Orgrimmar to arrange wind rider transport to Razor Hill. He’s the one who can help you get there.
id:6386: Gryshka wants you to fly to Razor Hill using the wind rider master Burok (since you've already met him) and deliver her letter to Grimtak there. Just talk to the wind rider to book the trip.
id:6387: The cook wants to reward top students with cleavers, so deliver the list to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge. Talk to gryphon master Brolan Galebeard first for faster travel.
id:6388: Take the cleavers to Gryth Thurden, the gryphon master, and ask him for a ride back to Kharanos. He’ll arrange transport once you deliver the items.
id:6391: A gryphon master offers a ride to Ironforge for a small fee. Once there, deliver Gremlock's list to Golnir Bouldertoe in the Deep Mountain Mining Guild. The gryphon will land you near the Great Forge District, where you'll find him.
id:6392: Talk to Brolan in Kharanos via gryphon (since you've already been there) to deliver cleavers to Gremlock Pilsnor. Speak to him when ready to go.
id:6441: A traveler needs you to collect satyr horns from Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian—specifically requested in Ratchet. They can’t fight the satyrs themselves, so they’re paying you to do it.
id:6442: The NPC wants you to kill 20 naga at the Zoram Strand to drive them out and protect their claimed land, as the naga’s return threatens the area. They don’t know why the naga came back but insist they must be stopped.
id:6462: The troll speaker’s kin were killed by Thistlefur furbolgs before reaching Zoram’gar, leaving their sacred charms in the furbolgs’ hands. They want you to recover the charms from chests in Thistlefur Hold, a cave at the northern end of Thistlefur Village near Astranaar. The furbolgs’ theft is both a loss and a mission to reclaim their tribe’s sacred items.
id:6482: The NPC is being held by furbolgs who captured and starved them, weakening their strength. They need you to help them escape and then take them to their sister Yama at Splintertree Post east of here.
id:6503: The NPC wants the player to hunt down the Ashenvale Outrunners who spied on and ambushed their group, seeking revenge for the attack that left them trapped.
id:6544: Torek's raiders plan to assault Silverwing Outpost and defeat leader Duriel Moonfire, who's defended by sentinels and warriors. They're asking you to join the attack, then report the results to Ertog Ragetusk after the battle.
id:6546: The Warsong Outrider warns {name} about mounting threats from satyr in eastern Ashenvale and naga in Azshara, urging readiness for battles ahead as the Alliance grows closer. They emphasize the need to prepare for multi-front conflicts in these contested zones.
id:6547: A Warsong Scout wants you to watch for elves hiding in shadows, fearing they'll reclaim the land. They need you to have orders from Kadrak ready.
id:6563: An NPC wants you to stop naga from harvesting sapphire clusters in Blackfathom Deeps—the crystals have powerful elemental energy that could be misused as an arcane component. The naga are working north of the Zoram Strand outpost.
id:6607: Nat Pagle wants to teach fishing but needs you to catch rare fish first. He says it's about determination, not experience—just sit and wait. Catch the listed rare fish to learn his techniques.
id:6608: Lumak says you're too good to teach and sends you to his friend Nat Pagle, a human who doesn't eat, in Dustwallow Marsh near Thermondor. Nat will teach you better fishing.
id:6610: The chef wants you to gather ingredients to make clamlettes, a new dish they’re excited about. They’ll teach exotic cooking and give you some clamlettes in return. Collect the listed supplies for them.
id:6611: Zamja sends you to Gadgetzan to find a goblin named Dirge who can teach you more cooking. She can’t help you anymore since you’ve mastered her skills but still want to learn. You’ll return later to share what Dirge teaches you.
id:6621: The NPC wants you to plant a banner northeast on furbolg totem mound to test their aggression, hold off attackers until chief Murgut arrives, then capture his totem. They need allies for this—no solo attempt. The goal is to leverage the furbolgs' honor-driven behavior to secure a key relic.
id:6622: The doctor NPC is testing your triage skills: save 15 patients by prioritizing critical injuries first, then bad injuries, then minor ones. Use provided bandages, and don’t let 6 patients die.
id:6623: Doctor Gregory Victor wants you to join him at Hammerfall for a big opportunity. He's the chief physician at Horde Trauma and thinks you should work with him. You need to go to him to get involved.
id:6624: An NPC is testing you on triage skills to join the Alliance Trauma. You need to heal 15 patients, prioritizing critical injuries, or you'll fail if 6 die.
id:6625: Gustaf VanHowzen, chief of Alliance Trauma, has personally invited you to join him in Theramore. He needs skilled medical help in a high-stakes situation and considers this a life-changing opportunity.
id:6641: A naga wants to stop Vorsha the Lasher, a hydra attacking Zoram'gar. They’ll need you to extinguish a ritual brazier on a nearby island to provoke Vorsha into battle. Bring strong allies—it’ll be dangerous.
id:6642: The Brotherhood values Dark Iron Ore and wants it as tribute. Deliver 10 pieces to earn favor with them.
id:6643: A Brotherhood member wants you to bring a Fiery Core to gain their favor, but many who searched for one died in the Molten Core's dangers. You need to find or retrieve a Fiery Core to complete this.
id:6644: Lokthos, authorized by the Thorium Brotherhood, asks you to give 1 Lava Core to earn their favor. The Brotherhood sympathizes with your situation and wants to support you through this exchange.
id:6645: Offer 2 Core Leather from Molten Core's Core Hounds to gain the Brotherhood's favor, needed for sacred recipes.
id:6646: An NPC in the Brotherhood wants you to offer 1 Blood of the Mountain to earn their favor. They believe the rare item will show your commitment. You need to provide the Blood to complete the quest.

id:6662: Nipsy needs a crate of rats delivered to his Deeprun kabob operation before they spoil. Take the tram across Deeprun, but keep your limbs inside during the ride to avoid getting injured.
id:6741: The NPC wants more armor scraps and is asking if you have any to give.
id:6781: The NPC wants you to gather more armor scraps to restock their troops' supplies. They’re running low and need the materials to keep soldiers equipped.

id:6826: Jeztor's Fleet needs the flesh of Stormpike Lieutenants to plan a precise attack. The player must collect it to help the fleet target powerful enemies.
id:6827: Mulverick wants revenge for being trapped in a dwarven dungeon and needs your help to target Stormpike Commanders for his war riders. He needs their flesh to fuel his attack, but they’re deep in enemy territory. Your job is to bring back what he needs to strike back.

id:6847: Master Ryson wants you to retrieve the All Seeing Eye stolen by Winterax trolls. Return it to him to unlock his support for your side.
id:6848: Master Ryson says the Syndicate won’t help with the Alterac war but needs the player to steal back their All Seeing Eye from Winterax trolls. They’ll offer their support once it’s recovered. The player must retrieve the Eye and return to Ryson for him to "examine" it.
id:6861: Zinfizzlex needs thorium, mithril, iron, and steamsaws to build a portable shredder. They point to Stormpike's lumber camp as the source for steamsaws, hinting they were seen there before being captured.
id:6862: Zinfizzlex needs thorium, mithril, iron, and a steamsaw from Frostwolf lumber camp to build his shredder. He’s been captured, so the player has to gather materials he can’t access himself.

id:6901: The commander needs assault orders to start the attack. They’re waiting for you to provide them so the battle can begin.
id:6922: Take the indestructible water globe powering the elemental to Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring for analysis. The globe’s foul liquid kept the beast strong, and its durability hints at a bigger threat.
id:6941: The commander wants you to eliminate Frostwolf guards along the lines and bring back medals from their lieutenants and legionnaires to pave the way for an air strike. They’ll deploy the attack once enough high-ranking enemies are defeated.
id:6942: Slidore's Fleet wants you to collect medals from Frostwolf warriors' corpses to weaken the front lines, enabling a gryphon attack. Bring the medals back once enough are gathered.
id:6943: Ichman needs you to hit Frostwolf's command, kill their leaders and protectors, and bring back their medals. The gryphons won’t fly until they see enemy trophies and blood. Head to the battlefield, grab medals, and prove victory is possible.
id:6961: Greet Great-father Winter and tell him what gift you want for the Feast of Winter Veil. Collect Smokywood Pastures treats to give to others who’ve been nice this year.
id:6962: The kid asks you to fetch gingerbread cookies and cold milk for Great-father Winter, who’s been working all day. They want to give him a treat as a friendly gesture.
id:6964: The speaker rants that goblins have turned Winter Veil into a gift-giving holiday, ignoring its true meaning as a time of renewal led by Greatfather Winter. They want you to ask Sagorne Creststrider about the Feast’s history, hoping you’ll focus on tradition instead of trinkets.
id:6982: An Alliance NPC asks you to retrieve supplies from the Horde's Coldtooth mine in the distant south. This will help the Alliance by taking much-needed equipment away from the Horde, who provide poor rations and subpar gear to their troops.
id:6983: An NPC says the Abominable Greench stole treats and kidnapped Metzen the Reindeer at Growless Cave in Hillsbrad Foothills. They want you to retrieve them before the celebration is ruined, warning the Greench is vicious with gnome minions.
id:6984: Smokywood Pastures thanks you for recovering their stolen treats and wants to give you a gift. Great-father Winter will hand you your Feast of Winter Veil reward for helping them. Talk to him to claim it.
id:6985: Take supplies from the Stormpike dwarves' Irondeep mine to weaken their Alterac Valley operations and stockpile gear. Control there is unstable, so expect shifting resistance from Alliance forces.
id:7001: The quest giver wants you to track down and tame nearby frostwolves using the muzzle they give. Return each tamed wolf to them to rebuild the Wolf Riders' stable. Enough wolves will let the unit rejoin the front-line patrol.
id:7002: An NPC wants you to kill rams used by the Stormpike cavalry and bring back their hides. They need the hides to make riding harnesses for the Frostwolf Wolf Riders. You need to know which enemy rams to target in the area.
id:7021: Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar gives treats to those who’ve been nice. Tell him what you want for the Feast of Winter Veil.
id:7022: Greatfather Winter wants you to talk to him about what you hope to get for the Feast of Winter Veil and stock up on Smokywood Pastures treats for others who’ve been nice this year.
id:7023: An NPC in Ironforge tells you to greet Greatfather Winter during the Winter Veil event. They want to know what you hope to receive for the Feast of Winter Veil if you've been "nice" this year.
id:7024: Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar asks you to tell him your wish for the Feast of Winter Veil to earn treats for being nice. Mention what you hope to get to claim your reward.
id:7025: Greatfather Winter asks the player to get him gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk after a long day of work. He wants a quick treat to recharge. The player must fetch the specific items for him.
id:7026: The Stormpike Brigade needs ram harnesses for their cavalry but can’t kill their own rams. They want you to attack the enemy base, kill their frostwolf mounts, and bring back the hides to make the harnesses.
id:7027: The Stormpike Brigade needs rams to revive their cavalry. Use the training collar in the valley to catch an Alterac ram and bring it back. Repeat until enough rams are collected to restart the ram riders.
id:7043: The quest giver says the Abominable Greench stole treats and is holding Metzen the Reindeer in Growless Cave, Hillsbrad Foothills. You need to retrieve them before the celebration is ruined and the children of Stormwind get disappointed. Watch out for the Greench's vicious green gnomes.
id:7045: Smokywood Pastures thanks you for recovering their stolen treats and wants to give you a Feast of Winter Veil gift. They’re having Greatfather Winter hand it over, so go talk to him to claim it.
id:7061: An NPC wants you to read a book about the Feast of Winter Veil, then deliver it to Baine Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff because he's interested in their people's legends.
id:7062: An NPC says goblins have corrupted the Feast of Winter Veil's true meaning and wants you to ask Historian Karnik at the Explorers' League. They believe the holiday is about renewal and honoring Greatfather Winter, not gifts. Karnik will explain the Feast's real history if you show interest in it.
id:7063: Read a book about the Feast of Winter Veil, then give it to Muradin Bronzebeard, who wants to know others are studying older legends.
id:7081: The NPC wants you to attack a graveyard with a Horde banner and pull it out. If you hold the spot for a few minutes, allied troops will come reinforce you.
id:7082: The NPC wants you to attack an Alliance-held graveyard by pulling their banner. Hold the spot for a few minutes to capture it and call in reinforcements.

id:7102: A commander wants you to capture a tower or bunker in Alterac Valley by replacing the enemy Horde banner with an Alliance one. Once you do that, the mission is complete, but if the area stays under Alliance control long enough, it will be destroyed.
id:7121: The NPC says your quartermaster needs supplies from Alterac mines and wants you to fetch them. Head west along the road to find him.
id:7122: An NPC wants you to take control of a mine in Alterac Valley by entering one the Alliance doesn’t control and killing its leader. Once captured, the mine will be secured with Alliance troops. Return to them after completing the mission.
id:7123: Frostwolf Quartermaster needs recruits for Alterac Valley mine tasks; talk to him at the bunker's west exit.
id:7124: The quest giver wants you to capture either Coldtooth or Irondeep mine for the Horde by killing the enemy leader currently in control. id:7141: The Explorers' League wants you to kill Frostwolf general Drek'Thar in the south of Alterac Valley to clear the way for their artifact hunt. Defeating him will weaken the orcs blocking their research. Head to Frostwolf Keep and take out Drek'Thar, then report back.
id:7142: Stormpike forces have invaded Alterac Valley. Defeat their general, Vanndar Stormpike, in Dun Baldar, {name}, then return here.
id:7161: The NPC requires you to retrieve the Frostwolf banner from a gnoll cave in the Valley as a trial for newcomers. Return it to earn the Frostwolf initiate's insignia.

id:7164: A Frostwolf leader honors your bravery and awards a new insignia. Present it to get your promoted rank’s emblem.

id:7166: Frostwolf leaders honor you as a legendary hero. Present your insignia to claim your status.

id:7170: The Guard acknowledges your earned reverence and asks you to present your insignia as proof of your standing.

id:7172: The Stormpike commander wants you to present their insignia to show their power and scare enemies. They believe displaying the emblem will let them command respect and spread fear in their rank.
id:7181: Korrak the Bloodrager leads the Winterax trolls in a fight for control of the Valley. Killing him will weaken their clan and disrupt the war effort. Your mission: eliminate Korrak to strike a key blow against the enemy.
id:7202: The NPC wants you to kill Winterax leader Korrak the Bloodrager to destroy his clan. They found his hierarchy in tomes—he’s hiding, so confront him directly.

id:7224: The NPC wants you to collect enemy armor scraps to craft gear for their troops. Bring the gathered materials to them.

id:7282: A soldier begs you to destroy their brother, now a mindless servant of the Banshee Queen. Head to the Field of Strife in Frostwolf territory to end his torment.
id:7301: An NPC faction wants you to investigate Tower Point West and Frostwolf Keep to find their pilots, who were shot down during a counterattack after their Wing Commanders were captured.
id:7302: The Wing Commanders—Guse, Jeztor, and Mulverick—were all shot down near key locations in Arathi Basin. You need to search those spots to find out what happened to them so a rescue can be planned.
id:7361: Najak, a troll warlord, wants you to kill and decapitate night elves to gain Darkspear favor, as their leader Staghelm is attacking trolls to erase their legacy.
id:7362: The Elder Crone wants you to collect gnome hair samples for Magatha’s research on their survivability. Bring back tufts of gnome hair to be recognized as a tauren ally.
id:7363: Commander Philips, a Frostwolf soldier working for Sylvanas, wants you to kill humans and return their bone chips to help the Dark Apothecaries cure the human condition. He’s passing this task to you after handling it himself.
id:7364: The High Tinkerer's rep wants gnomes protected from tauren killing and stealing their tufts. Bring tauren hooves to show you're a gnome ally.
id:7365: Staghelm demands you kill trolls on the battlefield because they claim to birth night elves, and wants you to steal their mojo as proof.
id:7366: The Archbishop wants you to kill the Forsaken undead and collect their black, disease-ridden hearts to be burned at the Cathedral of Light. He calls it an act of mercy. Bring the hearts to him for the ceremony.
id:7367: The Frostwolf mines are a threat—kill their explosives expert in a tower near Iceblood Garrison to disable them. Taking him out ensures safe passage through their territory.
id:7368: The speaker wants you to kill the Stormpike explosives expert in the first tower of the Field of Strife to stop their mines from reactivating. They offer a reward for the job, since they’re the one who originally placed the mines.
id:7381: Warmaster Laggrond wants Korrak killed again in case troll magic revived him and needs his skull as proof. Trolls’ tribal magics might bring the dead leader back, so the job’s a precaution. Just confirm Korrak’s dead and return with his skull.
id:7382: The NPC warns that trolls might have revived Korrak by not burning his corpse. They want you to kill Korrak if he appears, burn his body, and bring back his skull to prevent his resurrection.
id:7383: Go to the Oracle Tree northwest of Darnassus and collect a phial of moonwell water, which holds Elune's essence. Bring it back to the crossroads in front of Darnassus.
id:7385: The NPC wants you to bring a gallon of enemy blood—they accept bigger offerings. You need to collect and present one gallon.
id:7386: The Circle wants you to bring them big clusters of Frostwolf storm crystals. They collect them during long battles. You need to gather and offer these crystals to complete the quest.
id:7401: Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl wants you to kill dwarves in battle and remove their spines as proof, to deter enemies and showcase Frostwolf's power. Bring the spines back to her as evidence of your actions.
id:7402: Corporal Noreg Stormpike orders soldiers to kill orcs on the battlefield and return with a tusk or tooth as proof of each kill. The goal is to eliminate enemies and document each successful encounter.
id:7421: Najak wants you to keep defending the Darkspear by killing enemies and bringing back their heads.
id:7422: The High Tinkerer's gnomes are de-hoofing tauren as revenge over Alterac Valley. Your faction needs tufts to study their methods.
id:7423: A human asks you to collect more bone chips to save souls from a bleak existence as part of the downtrodden masses. They see each chip as a chance to rescue a trapped soul.
id:7424: A gnomish NPC wants you to make a target limp to teach bullies their people won’t be pushed around.
id:7425: Staghelm demands you collect mojo from dead trolls to silence them. Keep gathering until he’s satisfied.
id:7426: Commander Philips thinks Benedictus is a miracle and wants you to keep incinerating Forsaken hearts to spread his mercy. He’s counting on you to finish the job.
id:7427: An NPC is preparing to launch spines into Dun Baldar's Stormpike using a catapult for an attack. They need more spines to proceed. You must gather additional spines for the catapult.
id:7428: An NPC tells you to keep killing Frostwolf orcs to teach them pain and help gnomes thrive. They claim it's a "win-win" for both sides.
id:7490: Eitrigg wants the head of the Black Dragonflight's brood mother to secure the Horde's victory. Kill her and bring the head to him.
id:7491: Overlord Natoj is waiting in the Valley of Strength—Eitrigg just saluted you. He needs you to act fast so the Horde doesn’t wait longer.
id:7495: Defeat the Black Dragonflight's brood mother, then bring her head to the Grand Admiral to honor the King.
id:7496: Find Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes. He needs to speak with you, but the reason isn't clear yet.
id:7604: An NPC wants you to confirm the Sulfuron ingot you're giving to the Thorium Brotherhood is real. They won't be responsible if you get hurt while working with Sulfuras. You need to sign the contract to complete the quest.
id:7660: Quest giver will trade your old fast wolf for a new Arctic Wolf with the same speed but different appearance. Bring your current swift wolf and compare available models in the yard.

id:7672: Return your current Nightsaber to the vendor to receive a replacement with the same speed and power but a new cosmetic appearance. Choose from available sabers to customize your mount’s look.

id:7677: NPC offers to swap your white stallion for a new herd horse that's just as fast but has a different style. Bring your stallion to claim the replacement.
id:7678: The NPC will trade your palomino for a new one from their herd. The new horse is just as fast but has a different appearance—you can check the available steeds nearby to see options.
id:7737: The Brotherhood, impressed by your progress, wants you to collect Dark Iron Residue from Blackrock Depths to refine their fiery flux. Bring them all the residue you can find to earn more respect.
id:7761: Warchief Rend Blackhand warns the Quartermaster that a secure orb will only work for those with the Mark of Drakkisath, which is guarded by Drakkisath himself. The player needs the mark to access Blackwing’s lair.
