id:7782: Field Marshal Stonebridge in Valley of Heroes needs the player to discuss Blackrock-related threats. The Lord of Blackrock likely wants the player to investigate or confront a danger tied to the region. Head to Valley of Heroes and talk to Stonebridge to proceed.
id:7783: The Warchief's advisor Eitrigg wants Nefarian's head to confirm your victory. Return it to him to complete the quest.
id:7784: Find Overlord Natoj in the Valley of Strength. He's Blackrock's leader positioning for an attack.
id:7785: An NPC wants you to examine a vessel, saying it's crucial for rebirthing the Windseeker. You need to inspect it to help bring the Windseeker back.
id:7786: Thunderaan wants you to find elementium and use it to destroy the Firelord's physical body. They believe you can succeed where they couldn't and will give you their blessing if you do.

id:7899: The NPC wants to attract a crowd with prizes but needs small furry paws from Barrens or Darkshore cats. Bring them paws to get a Darkmoon Faire ticket in return.

id:8149: NPC wants you to deliver an offering to Uther's tomb in the Western Plaguelands to honor him during the Harvest Festival. Place it at his statue, then return before the festival ends—this request expires after the event.
id:8150: An NPC in Ashenvale wants you to place an offering at Grom Hellscream’s monument in Demon Fall Canyon and return before the Harvest Festival ends, as they’ll leave after that.
id:8193: An NPC is hosting a fishing contest: collect 40 tastyfish from Stranglethorn's coast and turn them in as one of the first 50 players worldwide. The fish spoil quickly, so you'll need to move fast to claim the prize.
id:8194: NPC wants you to sell them Tastyfish at a fair price, even after a fishing contest already had a winner. They’re still buying fish but not offering contest rewards anymore. Just bring Tastyfish to trade.
id:8221: Fishmaster Bluegill wants a Keefer's Angelfish for their catalog. They'll reward you when you catch and bring it.
id:8222: The Faire worker wants glowing scorpid blood because customers love glowing items. You need to collect it from scorpids in Sillithus, Blasted Lands, or Burning Steppes.
id:8223: The shopkeeper is thrilled with the glowing scorpid blood you collected—it makes their trinkets super popular with buyers. Even though they’ve got plenty now, they’ll keep trading tickets for more blood if you collect any. Just bring it to them for extra rewards.
id:8224: A machine wants a Dezian Queenfish for Fishmaster Bluegill’s catalog and will reward you for it. Catch one and return it.
id:8225: Fishmaster Bluegill wants a Brownell's Blue Striped Racer for their catalog. Bring one to them for a reward.
id:8249: The NPC's rogues need better lockpicking practice than Zan’s basic locks. Bring 5 Heavy Junkboxes; you can loot their contents but leave some coins in each. They’ll reward you with a favor for delivering.
id:8277: Beetix Ficklespragg needs stingers from stonelash scorpids and fangs from sand skitterers to cure his cousin Noggle’s venom sickness. Noggle got poisoned while gathering herbs, and the samples will let Beetix make an antidote. Collect the stingers and fangs to stop the poison.
id:8278: Noggle needs you to collect poison samples from several creatures in the far south. His antidote failed after a strong sting, and fewer samples are needed but from more sources.
id:8279: The quest giver, hunted by the Twilight's Hammer, needs the Twilight Lexicon to decode a tablet. The Lexicon’s three chapters are held by Twilight Keepers at their camps. Find and retrieve all three to complete the quest.
id:8280: An NPC at Cenarion Hold wants you to kill dredge strikers attacking supply caravans. They destroyed a shipment of morrowgrain, and thinning their numbers will keep supplies coming.
id:8281: NPC says supply lines are still vulnerable now that dredge strikers are gone, so you need to kill dredge crushers to prevent them from taking over. Your goal is to eliminate enough of the larger dredge crushers to secure the northern route.
id:8282: Noggle needs you to retrieve his satchel of rare reagents lost during an escape from Deathclasp, a giant scorpid. The satchel is in the southern mountain range behind Bronzebeard’s camp, and he’ll reward you for bringing it back to help Cenarion Hold’s potion supply.
id:8283: Captain Vish Kozus wants you to kill Deathclasp, a dangerous scorpid in the southern mountain range where silithid activity is rising. She’s threatening patrols and expeditions, and there’s a handsome reward for taking her down. Ask Vish Kozus at the Cenarion Hold Watchtower about payment after completing the job.
id:8284: The NPC wants you to find scattered clay tablet fragments in the former Twilight's Hammer camp northwest of the area, now overrun by elementals, to uncover clues about the cult's activities in Silithus. They’ve already recovered a few pieces but need the rest to piece together the story.
id:8285: An NPC wants you to find Ortell, a Twilight's Hammer deserter hiding in the mountains south of Southwind Village. Bring the restored tablet to convince him to help decipher it.
id:8287: A Cenarion Circle agent wants you to deliver a parchment to their leader, Commander Mar'alith, to help their forces drive Twilight's Hammer out of Silithus. The agent hopes this will end their own persecution by the faction.
id:8304: Natalia, your commanding officer, vanished after acting oddly and heading to Bronzebeard's camp. You need to question the dwarves there to find her.
id:8306: Go to Hive'Regal to find Natalia. Talk to the dwarves first for advice on fighting silithids. If she's gone mad, you might need to end it.
id:8307: The NPC wants to adapt to desert life and needs help finding out how Twilight's Hammer makes bitter sandworm meat edible. They ask you to investigate the Twilight's Hammer camp west of the area. Look for clues about their cooking methods or herb use.
id:8308: Brann wants you to take his letter to his old camp so his monkey gets taken care of. He's heading into an ancient Ahn'Qiraj tunnel to investigate a Titan and an Old God. Be wary of a night elf who's obsessed with the Old God.
id:8309: The NPC wants you to collect glyph rubbings from crystals in Hive'Regal to figure out why the hives are spawning more bugs. They think the glyphs might be linked to the increased activity and Madness. Grab the rubbings—they’re the last ones needed.
id:8310: The NPC wants to create an elixir to help read silithid and Qiraji glyphs. They need a brain from Hive'Regal, but a previous explorer never returned after getting two. You’ll have to retrieve one yourself and survive the trip.
id:8311: Jesper can't go trick-or-treating after Deathwing's attack, so he asks you to collect candy from big-city innkeepers and a gnome named Talvash in Ironforge. Bring the candy back to trade for some he already has.
id:8312: The Matron won’t let Spoops trick-or-treat, so they want you to collect Hallow’s End candy from city innkeepers and Kali Remik in Orgrimmar instead. Bring all the candy back to trade for something that lets you transform into spooky or silly creatures.
id:8313: Calandrath can help decipher a sandworm meat recipe using desert herbs you don't recognize. They have knowledge of local plants needed to understand it.
id:8314: NPCs have recreated glyphs on a crystal tied to Qiraji communication but can't unlock its secrets. Take the crystal to Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold for analysis.
id:8317: The NPC needs help making smoked desert dumplings to be ready today and will reward you for your help.
id:8318: The quest giver wants a stack of Twilight's Hammer's gibberish papers. They don’t know what the text means, but stealing it disrupts the cultists’ secret communication network. The goal is to reduce their ability to coordinate by removing the notes.
id:8319: An NPC wants you to collect encrypted texts to drive Twilight's Hammer from Silithus. Keep bringing them to help with the operation.
id:8320: Twilight's Hammer cultists in Silithus are a growing threat led by geolords. You need to attack their west camps and eliminate these leaders before their dangerous rituals escalate.
id:8321: Defeat Vyral the Vile, the Twilight's Hammer leader in a cave in northeast Silithus, then return his signet ring.
id:8323: The quest-giver, holding the Twilight Lexicon, wants you to collect encoded texts from Twilight's Hammer members to track if their former group is still searching for them. They’ll share useful info in return once you deliver the texts. Your goal: find and turn in any encoded documents from Twilight’s Hammer.
id:8324: Bring a good batch of encrypted texts. The decoding work takes time, and they need more to keep going.
id:8325: Your trainer wants you to thin the rogue mana wyrms west of Sunspire to reclaim the Burning Crystals. The Scourge invasion broke the isle’s magic, making the wyrms unstable and the crystals untappable. You need to reduce their numbers before returning.
id:8326: The NPC admits the Burning Crystals have corrupted more of the island than realized, turning lynxes feral. They need the player to kill the infected lynxes and collect their collars to craft a magical restraint and prevent more spread.
id:8327: Go talk to Lanthan Perilon, who’s standing west along the path. He’s your next contact and will explain the urgent task related to Falthrien Academy. This is more important than the Burning Crystals work happening at Sunspire.
id:8334: The NPC wants you to eliminate aggressive bestial tenders on Sunstrider Isle that were once used for gardening but have become uncontrollable threats. They’re forcing the NPC to destroy them for survival, and you need to act quickly before more harm is done.
id:8335: A blood elf named Felendren is holed up at Falthrien Academy, southwest of your location. He was banished for losing control to his magical addiction and became one of the Wretched. You need to kill him and the wraiths he commands before they threaten the Sunspire.
id:8338: A dark sliver of crystallized mana was found on a tainted arcane wraith and gives you a bad feeling. Arcanist Helion on Sunstrider Isle might know what to do with it. Take it to him.
id:8347: Magistrix Erona sends you to Silvermoon’s Falconwing Square to meet Outrunner Alarion after your success at Falthrien Academy. The Outrunners need help moving supplies between the islands and the mainland, and they want your assistance. Talk to Alarion south of your current location to get started.
id:8350: Magistrix Erona at Sunspire needs a package delivered to her inn in Falconwing Square immediately. The NPC can’t do it themselves due to staffing shortages and asks {name} to take the risk, warning the route outside Dawning Lane is dangerous.
id:8353: A child’s guardian wants you to cluck like a chicken to earn an Ironforge Mint, claiming it’s a treat they’ll love. Perform the clucking to get the reward.
id:8354: The NPC wants you to cluck like a chicken in exchange for an Undercity Mint, claiming it’s their treat for trick-or-treating. They admit mints might not *actually* be a chicken’s favorite, but you’ll need to cluck anyway to earn it. Just mimic the sound to get the reward.
id:8355: An NPC offers a Gnomeregan Gumdrop for a sick child if you make a train noise. They insist it's the price for the candy, so chugga-chugga when prompted.
id:8356: An NPC wants you to flex your muscles in your current costume to earn a Stormwind Nougat treat. They’ll only give the reward after you perform the flex, so do it to get the candy.
id:8357: An NPC (a trick-or-treating child) demands you dance for marzipan, claiming it's the "cost" of the treat. You need to perform a dance to earn the reward.
id:8358: An NPC wants you to make a train noise ("Chugga-chugga!") to get a Darkspear Gumdrop for a child. They insist on the "trick" despite your candy-collecting help.
id:8359: An NPC admires your costume and demands you flex once to prove your strength, promising Orgrimmar Nougat as a reward. Flex exactly when prompted to claim the Hallow's End treat.
id:8360: A child wants you to dance in exchange for marzipan. They call it part of the tradition, so show them your best moves to claim the treat.
id:8446: An NPC says this corrupted object might explain why dragons are emerging from the Dream. They want you to take it to druids in Moonglade or Cenarion Hold for analysis. The goal is to uncover its connection to the nightmare-wracked dragons.
id:8447: An NPC is using Lake Elune'ara's waters to cleanse an object of nightmares. Wait while the process is completed.
id:8463: The Wretched stole unstable mana crystals from an arcane sanctum, which could explode and damage the city. The speaker wants you to recover any crystals still in their original crates to avoid-looking bad.
id:8468: Silvermoon City wants Thaelis the Hungerer dead—he’s a Wretched ringleader who killed guards and terrorized citizens. Kill him and report to Sergeant Kan’ren to claim the reward.
id:8470: A Deadwood furbolg ritual totem radiates despair, symbolizing their corruption. Bring it to a furbolg in Timbermaw Hold once you’ve earned their trust.
id:8472: Broken arcane patrollers in Silvermoon’s northwest ruins attack on sight. Collect their still-functional cores to reclaim their power for the city. Turn them in to the quest-giver for reuse.
id:8473: The quest giver wants you to stop treants in the Scorched Grove from regrowing the forest, which they blame for aiding the Scourge. They tried reasoning but failed, so you’ll have to use force.
id:8474: The NPC wants you to find the maker of Old Whitebark's pendant by tracking down who L.R. is. The pendant's initials are the key to identifying its creator.
id:8475: An NPC wants you to help their men kill undead creatures coming down the Dead Scar, a cursed area in Eversong Woods that's been plagued since Arthas's Scourge attack.
id:8476: The Amani trolls are raiding your people's lands and need to be stopped. You're being sent to attack their settlements at Zeb'Watha and Tor'Watha.
id:8477: A sin'dorei artisan wants the magical, well-balanced hammer used by Amani Spearcrafter Otembe to craft a weapon for you. They’ll trade it for the hammer you retrieve, highlighting its value to both Amani and sin’dorei craftsmen. Bring the tool to them for a custom weapon in return.
id:8479: Ven'jashi, a Darkspear trapped and poisoned by Zul'Marosh, wants you to kill the evil troll leader. He’s defiant and won’t die until you bring back Zul’Marosh’s head, which you can find across the lake in Zeb'Watha.
id:8480: An NPC says the Wretched attacked Sunsail Anchorage and stole most of their weapons. They need the player to retrieve the armaments to show those ruffians who's boss.
id:8481: The Winterfall tribe's leader wants you to plant a torch in Grolnar's cave to summon the demon controlling them. Killing the demon will start healing the tribe and saving Timbermaw Hold.
id:8482: Hand over the maps of Eversong Woods’ strategic buildings and an arcane sanctum diagram to Captain Aeldon Sunbrand—they were found on a Darnassian spy. The documents likely reveal the spy’s plans, and Aeldon needs them to investigate or counter the threat.
id:8483: An NPC orders you to kill Prospector Anvilward at the North Sanctum, quietly retrieve his head, and warn that Ironforge must stop interfering.
id:8486: The NPC is frustrated with Caidanis for overloading the West Sanctum, causing a destroyed energy converter and arcane wraiths to spawn. They need you to kill the wraiths to stabilize the area before repairs can begin.
id:8487: An NPC wants to know if the arcane taint in the soil from the ruined sanctum can be reversed. They’re asking you to collect soil samples so they can study the corruption and find a way to restore the area. The taint attracts undead and messes with ley line energy.
id:8488: An NPC warns you about nearby Scourge and urges you to prepare for battle. They sense something's wrong and need you to fight them off.
id:8490: The NPC wants you to use a crystal to reactivate the Eastern Runestone, which can help restore defenses. Scourge will attack while you do it, so protect the runestone until the crystal's energy takes effect.
id:8491: A ranger needs you to collect springpaw pelts from the woods north of the camp. The pelts are in high demand and their hunters are tied up due to fights with the Amani. They’ll trade the pelts for custom armor.
id:8492: An NPC is collecting stacks of twenty copper bars for the Alliance. They need the materials to support the Ahn'Qiraj War effort. You need to gather and provide the copper bars.
id:8493: The Alliance needs more copper bars for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. They’re asking you to gather and deliver additional stacks.
id:8494: An NPC wants you to gather iron bars in stacks of 20 to help the Alliance prepare for war in Ahn'Qiraj. They need a lot, so just bring them as requested.
id:8495: The Alliance needs 20 more iron bars to build weapons, armor, and steam tanks for the bug hunt. The NPC, annoyed but sarcastically fond, reminds you to prioritize this over your usual adventuring.
id:8499: Captain has asked for thorium bars to build steam tanks for the war effort in Silithus. They need a lot and want you to help gather them. Find a way to get the required number of thorium bars and turn them in.
id:8500: An Alliance NPC is collecting thorium bars for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. They need your spare bars to support the campaign.
id:8501: Commander Mar'alith needs you to destroy the airborne Hive'Ashi stingers threatening their operations. Take them out, then report back.
id:8502: Commander Mar'alith wants you to take out Hive'Ashi workers to curb their growing threat. Focus on their worker units specifically, then report back after the job’s done.
id:8503: A researcher needs a lot of stranglekelp for the Alliance. They want you to gather and donate it, even though it's used for many helpful things. Your job is to provide as much as possible.
id:8504: The Alliance NPC needs 20 more stranglekelp to restock supplies. They’re short on the kelp, so {name} asks you to gather it quickly. No time to waste—get the stranglekelp and return.
id:8505: An Alliance expert asks you to gather purple lotus flowers to support their war efforts. They need the herbs preserved and delivered to ensure enough supplies for their purposes.
id:8506: Alliance rep wants more purple lotus for their collection. They need you to gather and return additional herbs.
id:8509: Alliance rep needs you to collect lots of Arthas' Tears for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. They’re short on details but say the herbs are urgent—just bring them back.
id:8510: The Alliance needs more Arthas' Tears, asking you to collect them again from where you previously gathered. They want to prepare for an offensive against Ahn'Qiraj’s forces.
id:8511: A Stoneflayer Skinner asks you to collect light leather for the Alliance's Ahn'Qiraj war effort, since they need to focus on tanning. You'll gather and return the skins to them directly.
id:8512: An Alliance NPC tells you they need 10 light leather for war supplies. Bring a stack of ten to them.
id:8513: The Alliance is collecting medium leather for the war, and this NPC needs you to gather and deliver whatever sources you find. Bring all the medium leather you can to them directly.
id:8514: The Alliance officer needs more medium leather to meet their quota. You’ll collect and deliver additional pieces beyond what’s already gathered.
id:8515: The Alliance needs thick leather for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort, and this NPC wants you to gather a large stack to turn in. They’re short on supplies and need it to make gear, so bring back as much thick leather as possible.
id:8516: The Alliance needs 80,000 thick leather strips to build gear and Engineering items. They’re still short, so the NPC wants you to gather more. Bring the leather to them to help with the effort.
id:8517: The Alliance needs linen bandages for the war at Ahn'Qiraj, and this NPC is leading the collection effort. They’re asking you to help gather as many as possible to prepare for the prolonged conflict.
id:8518: An Alliance healer needs you to collect linen bandages to finish their assignment. They require multiple bandages to fulfill their mission.
id:8520: The Alliance is collecting silk bandages to equip soldiers for the Ahn'Qiraj War. You need to help gather them to meet their urgent medical needs.
id:8521: The Alliance has collected 600,000 silk bandages but needs more. They ask you to produce additional supplies to meet ongoing demand.
id:8522: An Alliance officer asks you to donate runecloth bandages to help treat soldiers in the war. They need supplies now that the conflict is inevitable, and you can contribute whatever stock you have.
id:8523: An Alliance representative asks you to collect runecloth bandages again, thanking you for past help but stressing there's more work needed. Bring the bandages back to them to support the Alliance's efforts.
id:8524: An NPC argues soldiers should have food and asks you to catch, cook, and return a whole bunch of Rainbow Fin Albacore. The player needs to fish raw albacore, cook them, and bring the cooked fish back.
id:8525: Slicky Gastronome, a gnome cook, needs more Rainbow Fin Albacore. They want the player to catch and bring back the fish to help the Alliance.
id:8526: An NPC forced into volunteering by their dad needs you to gather roast raptor for Ahn'Qiraj soldiers. They hate meat, but the troops need the food. Bring a lot of it.
id:8528: The NPC is stockpiling cooked spotted yellowtail to feed Alliance soldiers when the Ahn'Qiraj war starts. They need the player to gather the fish because it’s versatile, stores well, and lacks the strong smell of other saltwater fish.
id:8529: Alliance needs more Spotted Yellowtail. The same NPC who asked you to fish them before wants another batch, faster this time. Catch and deliver.
id:8532: The NPC needs copper bars, not ore, because the Horde lacks smelters. They want you to smelt copper ore into bars and bring them.
id:8533: The NPC wants you to mine copper ore, smelt it into bars, and return them to help the Horde. They’re short on resources and need your mining skills to meet demand. Just focus on gathering and processing copper efficiently.
id:8539: Commander Mar'alith wants you to eliminate Hive'Zora hive sisters during the assault. Report back to them once the task is done.
id:8542: The Horde is preparing for war at Ahn'Qiraj, and this blacksmith needs you to make as many tin bars as possible and bring them back. They’re prioritizing supplies over weapons, so focus on crafting and trading tin bars to help the front lines.
id:8543: A Horde contact is stressed and demands faster tin bar deliveries to support the war effort. They'll stay angry until you keep supplying more, so prioritize rushing those bars back to them.
id:8544: An NPC wants the highest Qiraji leader bindings to craft spaulders more fearsome than Nefarian’s wings. Bring those bindings to complete the quest.
id:8545: An NPC in charge of gathering mithril bars for the Horde's war prep wants you to mine mithril and smelt it into bars. They still need more to build what they’ll require.
id:8546: The NPC needs more mithril bars to build armor and weapons for the battle against Ahn'Qiraj's insects. Bring them stacks of mithril bars until their quota is met.
id:8547: Marsilla Dawnstar in Falconwing Square wants your Collector's Edition voucher. Turn it in to get a companion as a thank-you gift.
id:8549: An NPC wants you to gather peacebloom for the Horde to make potions for the Ahn'Qiraj War. They need a good quantity of the herb. Just bring it back to them.
id:8550: The Horde NPC needs more peacebloom for potions to support the war effort. They'll take the same amount as before, either gathered now or from your inventory if you already have it.
id:8556: The NPC wants you to collect a Qiraji lieutenant’s ring and idols to swap corrupted gems with purer ones, creating a strong ring for your class. They need the ring and idols to craft it.
id:8557: NPC offers to craft protective gear for Ahn'Qiraj battle; needs a Qiraji drape, idols, and scarabs to resize and attach a clasp.
id:8558: The Circle member wants you to prove your loyalty by using Qiraji materials to craft a powerful weapon. They’ll forge a Sickle of Unyielding Strength from Qiraji artifacts once you show allegiance.
id:8559: An NPC wants you to gather the Qiraji bindings of command and minor components to craft powerful boots for fighting enemies. They claim the gear is essential for overcoming the enemy.
id:8560: A questgiver wants you to help them gain Ouro's trust by collecting a sample of his legendary, nearly impervious skin. They’ll use it to craft powerful leggings for you, but you need to bring the sample and a few other small items to complete the deal. Ouro is a giant, ancient sandworm feared as a creation of an Old God.
id:8561: The NPC is losing their mind from the Twin Emperors' whispers and can't rescue their brother Arygos. They want to turn the Emperors' powerful crowns into a weapon for revenge and offer the player a strong headpiece in exchange for gathering materials.
id:8562: An Old God beneath Ahn'Qiraj is stirring and will attack Azeroth when the stars align. Kill it before it lashes out and return with a piece of its husk to claim armor "fit for one who has slain a god."
id:8579: A mortal wants to rescue our enslaved allies inside Ahn'Qiraj, but even dragons can't save them without falling under C'Thun's control. We need you to help when all hope seems gone.
id:8580: Pele'keiki needs you to gather firebloom for the Horde's Ahn'Qiraj war effort. He doesn’t care what they use it for—explosives, Alliance steam tanks, or anything else. Just get him lots of firebloom.
id:8581: Pele'keiki wants more firebloom to make bombs for fighting insects in Ahn'Qiraj. Bring at least as much as your last delivery to make him happy.
id:8582: A {class} needs you to gather purple lotuses for potions and experiments to support the Horde's war effort at Ahn'Qiraj. They’ll use the flowers for battle supplies and new formulas but need large quantities. Collect as many purple lotuses as you can.
id:8583: The Horde herbalist needs 20 purple lotus samples for research, even though new uses haven’t been found yet. Collect them and bring them back to turn in.
id:8588: A Horde NPC needs heavy leather for war supplies like armor and tarps. They want you to gather a bundle of it. Bring it back to them to proceed.
id:8589: The quartermaster wants more heavy leather to meet growing demands from the generals and zeppelin masters. They’re asking you to deliver as many stacks as possible quickly.
id:8590: A Horde NPC asks you to gather thick leather skins to help prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War. They need the materials for making war supplies and want you to collect them. You'll earn honor and the Horde's gratitude for helping.
id:8591: A Horde NPC needs thick leather for war prep. They ask you to gather and return it for recognition.
id:8592: The Oracle is being driven mad by the Twin Emperors and can't save their brother Arygos. They want revenge by transmuting Qiraji crowns into a powerful tiara for you, but you’ll need to gather components first.
id:8593: An Oracle wants you to gather a sample of Ouro’s sandworm skin and other components to craft powerful leggings. They claim Ouro’s skin is tough but flexible, and they need proof of your worth to work together. Focus on getting the materials—they’ll handle the rest.
id:8594: NPC wants player to collect high-ranking Qiraji leader bindings to craft fearsome shoulder armor that outshadows Nefarian's wings. Task focuses on obtaining specific Qiraji bindings for a dragon-wing-inspired pauldron upgrade.
id:8595: The NPC acknowledges your first victory over a Qiraji lord but wants you to defeat more to prove your worth. Qiraji lords are numerous and powerful, so keep taking them down to show you’re a true champion.
id:8596: A qiraji oracle wants you to bring their bindings of command and other minor parts so they can make strong boots to help fight the enemy.
id:8600: The NPC wants you to gather rugged leather skins to support the Horde's Ahn'Qiraj war effort. They need the materials to strengthen their forces, so bring back the specified number of leather skins.
id:8601: A Horde leader asks you to gather a stack of rugged leather to help prepare for the coming war at Ahn'Qiraj, stressing they can't afford delays. They want to ensure their forces are equipped and ready.
id:8602: A Stormcaller wants you to retrieve high-ranking Qiraji leader bindings. They’ll use them to craft fearsome pauldrons, more dreadful than Nefarian’s wings.
id:8603: The Old God under Ahn'Qiraj will attack when the stars align, unleashing wrath on all life. Defeat him by retrieving a piece of his husk to claim armor strong enough to kill a god.
id:8604: The Horde NPC is collecting wool bandages for soldiers in the Ahn'Qiraj war—they need them to survive in the field where healers aren’t available. Bring as many as you can here for a reward.
id:8605: An NPC needs more wool bandages for the war effort. They want you to gather some to help reduce casualties. Your help is appreciated and will go toward supporting the Horde.
id:8607: A Horde rep needs you to gather lots of mageweave bandages (fresh ones are preferred but not required) and bring them back for a reward. They’re collecting supplies for the front lines.
id:8608: An NPC aiding the Ahn'Qiraj war effort asks the player to gather a stack of mageweave bandages again. They need the bandages for the ongoing conflict but don’t explain how. The task is a repeat request tied to the same war effort as before.
id:8609: A Horde NPC needs runecloth bandages to supply soldiers preparing for war against the silithid. They ask for your help gathering them.
id:8610: The NPC wants more runecloth bandages for the upcoming battle at Ahn'Qiraj. They need supplies to survive the insect and master creatures there. If you have more bandages, bring them to this NPC again.
id:8611: The Horde is prepping for war against Ahn'Qiraj and needs lean wolf steaks to feed troops. This NPC can't leave their post, so they want you to kill wolves, cook the meat into lean steaks, and bring them back. Focus on wolves and cooked steaks—no raw meat or wrong animals.
id:8612: The Horde needs another stack of lean wolf steaks to keep soldiers fed. They want them quicker than your last delivery.
id:8613: An NPC fisherman needs help gathering 50 Spotted Yellowtail for the Horde’s Ahn'Qiraj war effort. He’s been tasked with collecting a large batch and can’t do it alone. The player must fish the required amount to assist.
id:8614: An NPC needs more spotted yellowtail to feed the Horde's warriors for the Ahn'Qiraj War. They want you to catch and cook the fish, then bring it back to them.
id:8615: An NPC needs baked salmon for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. They want you to collect it because it’s nourishing and lasts long. You’ll need to prepare and bring the salmon to them.
id:8616: An NPC needs more baked salmon for the Horde's war effort since the last batch didn't meet the quota. They ask the player to deliver another stack.
id:8621: A qiraji mage wants you to collect the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance and minor components to craft a powerful boot set. They’re useful for fighting enemies. Bring the items to create them.
id:8622: An NPC warns that an Old God is awakening beneath Ahn'Qiraj and will attack when the stars align. They want you to find and slay him first, then bring back a piece of his husk to claim the Stormcaller’s Hauberk, armor "fit for one who has slain a god."
id:8623: The speaker, trying to save their brother Arygos, wants you to gather components to transmute the Twin Emperors' crowns into a powerful headpiece for revenge. They need your help to create the Stormcaller's Diadem, which will aid their plan against the Qiraji rulers.
id:8624: The Stormcaller will craft powerful leggings if you bring a sample of Ouro the sandworm's thick, flexible skin plus other ingredients. They need the material to test your worth and create gear capable of withstanding Ouro's legendary defenses.
id:8625: An NPC wants you to collect the high-ranking Qiraji leaders' bindings to craft menacing pauldrons, claiming they'll be even more intimidating than Nefarian's wings. The task focuses on obtaining those specific bindings for the armor upgrade.

id:8891: Magister Duskwither’s journal details attempts to filter corrupted magic—bring it back to him to explain what’s happening at Duskwither Spire.
id:8892: An NPC tells you Sunsail Anchorage is overrun by Wretched scum and wants you to clear them out. They mention reinforcements are coming, but for now you need to defeat the Wretched west of Fairbreeze Village.
id:8894: The groundskeeper needs help clearing magical beasts that overran the area after the magister and apprentices left. They can’t maintain the grounds while these creatures are running wild.
id:8895: Your contact gives you a letter to deliver to Ley-Keeper Caidanis, the arcanist in charge of the North Sanctum's upkeep, located southwest of Falconwing Square. Avoid trivial conversation to respect his importance.
id:8897: A soldier at the gate wants you to deliver a note to his sweetheart, Colara, fearing she might leave him for someone richer now that he's stuck guarding the city with low pay and uncertain returns. He's worried their limited time together and his unstable situation could push her away.
id:8898: A Stormwind bank employee can't stop thinking about a woman he met there and needs you to deliver a rewritten love letter to her. He’s too nervous to send it himself, so he’s asking for your help to ensure it reaches Colara safely.
id:8899: Colara is being courted by a being who's struggling to find words to express her beauty. They're worried that if they don't act soon, someone else might win her affection. The player needs to help them move forward with their plea.
id:8900: A character wants you to deliver a heartfelt letter to Elenia, someone they connected with before others mocked their bond. They stopped speaking but still miss her, and need you to ensure she receives this message directly.
id:8901: A Forsaken NPC wants you to deliver a love letter to Elenia in the Undercity, asking her to come to Mulgore. They’re hoping she’ll accept and join them.
id:8902: A former betrothed asks you to deliver a letter to Elenia. They want to reconnect after years apart but are too nervous to do it themselves.
id:8979: Fenstad thinks new fragrances are causing erratic behavior and wants you to deliver a cologne and perfume bottle to Apothecary Zinge. He’ll pay you back for the scents once you return with them.
id:8980: Zinge found mind control potion ingredients, some linked to the Royal Apothecary Society, confirming Fenstad's suspicions. Player needs to investigate the mind control connection.
id:8981: An NPC asks if you’re here to deliver a gift to your favorite leader, seeking love and adoration. Your task is to hand over the present to complete the quest.
id:8982: Track down the supplier of the perfume by investigating Apothecary Katrina, who bought a bottle from innkeeper Norman. The player needs to follow this lead to uncover the source.
id:8983: The supplier is having issues with their product and wants to find out why. Mara Rennick, the new merchant, needs someone to help her track a delivery to a tailor in the Magic Quarter to check its condition. You need to find the tailor to see what happened to the goods.
id:8984: An NPC tells you to investigate apothecary Staffron Lerent, who works in a secluded area past Ravenholdt Manor in Hillsbrad, as he may be undermining efforts. They bought goods from him but found him odd.
id:8993: An NPC asks if you’re there to deliver a gift of love and adoration to the leader. You must give the present to complete the quest.
id:9024: Aristan thinks the guards might be distracted by new perfumes and colognes. He wants you to bring a bottle of each to Morgan Pestle and tell him the theory. He'll pay for the items when you come back.
id:9025: Morgan found traces of love potion and mind-altering draught ingredients, suspecting something beyond normal perfume use. They think Aristan’s theory might be right and want the player to investigate the suspicious substances.
id:9026: Your contact wants you to track the source of the unusual activity at The Gilded Rose by talking to Allison. If she's selling them, she'll know where they came from. Focus on getting info from her about the flow of people there.
id:9027: The speaker suspects the cologne is causing a stir and wants the player to track down merchant Evert Sorisam, who sold it and was delivering more to The Finest Thread. The player needs to investigate the source of the product and its effects.
id:9028: The NPC denies treason, saying their materials came from Staffron Lerent, an apothecary in the Hillsbrad Foothills near Ravenholdt Manor. You need to track down Staffron to uncover the source.
id:9035: An apprentice begs for help after the Wretched stole their mana crystals, wands, and spellbooks. Meledor chased the thieves down the road—player needs to assist him.
id:9062: The NPC needs their instructor's elemental grimoire, which a Wretched threw into the river. They can’t find it themselves and offer coin if you retrieve it.
id:9066: The NPC wants you to discipline their two dimwitted students with a wand, which you’ll find west of the Dead Scar. They insist this is a lesson in accountability and will reward you afterward.
id:9067: Party host needs supplies for a Quel’Thalas celebration: get a Suntouched Special Reserve from Silvermoon’s Vinemaster Suntouched, Springpaw Appetizers from Zalene Firstlight at Farstrider Retreat, and fireworks from Halis Dawnstrider in Fairbreeze Village. Hurry to finish the list.
id:9076: An NPC wants you to kill Aldaron, the Wretched leader spotted on the top floor near the anchorage, to make an example now that they’re distracted by foul magic. Bring his head for a reward.
id:9085: After taking down the summoning circles' defenses, fight the shadow acolytes guarding them. Use their necrotic runes to reveal them, then destroy with magic or strength.
id:9119: Velania's apprentice needs help fixing a malfunction at the West Sanctum. Head southwest to assist them.
id:9130: A supplies volunteer is needed to get materiel from Silvermoon City. Skymaster Brightdawn will give you instructions on how to get there.
id:9133: NPC offers to fly you to Silvermoon City for a small fee, claiming it’s safer than walking. Upon arrival, talk to Sathren Azuredawn in the Bazaar, then return to the NPC to confirm you’ve braved the flight.
id:9134: Skymistress Gloaming needs you to deliver goods for final inspection at Silvermoon City's Shepherd's Gate. If you've spoken to Skymaster Brightdawn in Fairbreeze Village, fly back and give them to Sathiel.
id:9135: Skymaster Brightdawn in Fairbreeze Village checks if you've already met with them to arrange a quick flight back to Sathiel. If you have, you just need to pay a small fare to return immediately.
id:9138: The speaker is urging you to go to Suncrown Village northeast of your current location right away. The Scourge, specifically spider-like Nerubians, have overrun the area and are a major threat. They need you to deal with them to help reclaim Quel'Thalas.
id:9139: An NPC wants you to reclaim Goldenmist Village from high elf ghosts to the northwest. The Scourge took over the area using their spectral tactics. Head west from Tranquillien and defeat the ghosts and wraiths there.
id:9140: A Scourge force is attacking Windrunner Village, and you need to reduce their numbers. The Sanctum of the Sun wants the Scourge remains for study. Head to the village and clear out the enemies.
id:9143: A lieutenant botched a battle by rushing into it unprepared, and now he’s demanding revenge against the trolls in Zeb'Sora. The NPC wants you to travel east across the lake, kill the trolls, and bring back their ears to make a necklace.
id:9144: An NPC’s nephew went to the Ghostlands on a secret mission and hasn’t returned. He’s worried about his missing "son" and wants you to find him there.
id:9145: Ranger Valanna's injured after a failed ambush on Shadowpine trolls near Lake Elrendar. Her lieutenant’s incompetence caused heavy losses, so she sent you to find backup. Locate her and Ranger Salissa at the Farstrider Enclave.
id:9146: The NPC asks you to check if Ranger Salissa reached the Farstrider Enclave on the lake's south edge and report to Captain Helios for help. They’re worried Salissa might be missing and need Helios to send reinforcements. Head to the enclave, confirm Salissa’s status, and relay the situation to Helios.
id:9147: The apothecary needs plagued blood samples from beasts south of the river to save a sick blood elf. Hunt infected animals, collect enough blood, and return to make a cure.
id:9148: A sickly traveler asks you to deliver a letter from Regent Lord Theron to Arcanist Vandril in Tranquillien. The town is south along the road. Giving the letter to Vandril is your next step.
id:9149: The NPC wants you to collect murloc spines to study how the plague affects their marrow, hoping to find clues for a cure. They’re curious why murlocs retain free will as undead, and need the spines to analyze. Bring the spines northwest to help them investigate.
id:9150: The NPC wants you to recover crystallized essences from bizarre creatures at the abandoned Sanctum of the Moon, which they say is being wasted. They’re prioritizing salvaging resources from the neglected site to reuse them at the active Sanctum of the Sun.
id:9151: Magisters from Silvermoon have rebuilt the sanctum and pushed back the Scourge, planning to attack Deatholme, Dar'Khan's stronghold. They want you to join as a {class} and help lead their offensive.
id:9152: Tomber's cart was attacked by ghouls west of town—he needs you to retrieve it. Head past the graveyard, through the Dead Scar fork, and recover the supplies to get his business back on track for the war effort.
id:9153: An NPC wants you to destroy undead creatures near magical circles supporting Scourge necropolises. They believe disabling the creatures will weaken the circles. The quest needs team effort, as the fortresses affect both Horde and Alliance zones.
id:9154: Take this document to Light's Hope Chapel's Keeper in the Eastern Plaguelands to join the Argent Dawn against the Scourge. The Lich King’s growing forces are threatening their lands, and they need volunteers to help defend them. Just deliver the document to prove your commitment and join the fight.
id:9155: The NPC wants you to weaken the Scourge in the Dead Scar, a path of destruction left by Arthas. Succeed, and they’ll recommend you to others.
id:9156: Deathstalker Rathiel wants Knucklerot and Luzran, deadly creatures made by Dar'Khan, dead. They’re near Howling and Bleeding Ziggurats—kill them and bring their heads to Rathiel for the bounty.
id:9157: Villagers in Suncrown Village were enslaved by an elemental named Aquantion after a corrupted ritual. The player must retrieve wave-shaped medallions from the bottom of a lake to free the villagers' spirits.
id:9158: The NPC asks you to hunt ghostclaw lynxes east and south of their location to stop the plague spreading through the Ghostlands' wildlife. They’re short on help and need you to kill enough lynxes to contain the tainted creatures.
id:9159: Gara'jal wants you to hunt dangerous plague-infected creatures. Kill the spindleweb lurkers in the Dead Scar and the vampiric mistbats nearby. Report back to him after you're done.
id:9160: An NPC wants you to check out a night elf camp at An'daroth northwest of the Dead Scar. They took over the old high elf nexus, and you need to kill their troops to investigate their motives.
id:9161: Dar'Khan Drathir, a former elf who betrayed his kind to join the Scourge, used Dawnstar Spire as a hideout. {name} needs to search the tower for journals or notes to figure out his plans and weaknesses.
id:9162: Vynna wants you to read a journal detailing Dar'Khan's bitter hatred and schemes. His soul's dark motivations are written in depth, which Vynna might find useful. Take notes on his machinations before reporting back.
id:9163: The NPC wants you to sneak onto Shalandis Isle to steal night elf plans from their island or ship, to uncover their hidden agenda. Just grab any documents or intel you find there.
id:9164: An NPC gives you a draught to free prisoners from alchemical stupors in Deatholme, warning it causes confusion and nausea but is better than Scourge plans. Use it to rescue captives there.
id:9166: Take the night elf plans to An'telas east of Sungraze Peak. Magister Sylastor there will analyze them to uncover night elf secrets and help fight the Scourge.
id:9167: Your allies the Forsaken want you to kill Dar'Khan, who stole the Sunwell’s power, and bring his head to Deatholme—a Scourge stronghold south of the Dead Scar. Vengeance is the goal after years of Scourge control in the Ghostlands.
id:9169: The NPC thinks night elves are using moon crystals to spy and needs you to stop them. You must retrieve a controlling orb from a night elf at An'owyn and use it to deactivate the moon crystal there. The goal is to disrupt their spying operation before it’s powered up.
id:9170: Kill Dar'Khan's four top Scourge lieutenants—Masophet, Jurion, Borgoth, and Mirdoran—in the Ghostlands. Their deaths will break the Scourge's command structure and weaken their undead forces.
id:9171: Dame Auriferous needs fresh kills from Dead Scar's southwest to make crunchy dishes for Milady. She wants spindleweb lurkers—there's no food here otherwise.
id:9172: Magister Kaendris at the Sanctum of the Sun southwest needs your report on Scourge weaknesses analyzed with Forsaken help. Hurry—Dar'Khan is watching and they need the info fast.
id:9173: Lady Sylvanas wants you to take back Windrunner Spire, which is now overrun by the Scourge. Head south, take the right fork, cross the Dead Scar, and go southwest to reach it.
id:9174: An elemental named Aquantion betrayed his creators by teaming with murlocs to sabotage their magic, killing many. You need to place medallions at the Altar of Tidal Mastery in the lake to summon him, then destroy him before his uncontrolled power causes more harm. The speaker wants revenge and an end to their suffering.
id:9175: Player found a necklace likely owned by Sylvanas Windrunner. Take it to High Executor Mavren in Tranquillien—he’s the top Forsaken leader and will handle it.
id:9176: Dar'Khan promised the Scourge two Sunwell-powered elven stones—light and flame—at the Twin Ziggurats in the Dead Scar. They’re likely still there, and their warding power could help fight the Scourge.
id:9177: Deliver a gift from Lady Sylvanas’s sister, Alleria, to Sylvanas in the Undercity’s Royal Quarter. Use the orb in Sunfury Spire’s Inner Sanctum to teleport, then take the elevator down and follow the map to the Royal Quarter.
id:9180: An NPC gives you a gift from Alleria for Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity. Use the Sunfury Spire orb to teleport there, ride the elevator down, and deliver it to Sylvanas in the Royal Quarter.
id:9192: An NPC warns that Blackpaw gnolls have seized the strategically vital Underlight Mines southwest of town. They urge you to secure the mine to keep resources flowing, directing you to take the south road, fork right past a ziggurat, then west on a dirt path.
id:9193: An NPC wants you to check out the Amani Catacombs because trolls there are coming back to life. You need to burn any dead troll remains to stop them from rising again. Head northwest from the enclave to reach the western entrance.
id:9199: An NPC wants proof the undead trolls in Sungraze Peak’s catacombs are destroyed, suspecting their juju (glowing power sources) keeps them animated. You’ll enter the Amani Catacombs on the mountain’s north face to retrieve this proof, likely by disabling or collecting the juju.
id:9207: Magister Quallestis needs ore samples from Sanctum of the Sun but gnolls are in the way. Collect tin and copper from exposed veins and gnoll carriers, then bring them to Quallestis east across Dead Scar near Sungraze Peak.
id:9212: The NPC in the cage says trolls are holding them to sacrifice. They need you to help break their cage lock and escort them back to the Farstrider Enclave for rescue. Captain Helios will reward you.
id:9214: An NPC wants you to kill Shadowpine trolls in Zeb'Tela and Zeb'Nowa to weaken them before targeting Deatholme, and to collect their weapons for the fight against the Scourge. Focus on hitting their camps hard in those areas.
id:9215: Captain Helios wants Kel'gash's head—chieftain of Shadowpine trolls in Zeb'Nowa. Reward's on offer, but no promotions involved.
id:9216: A healer wants zombie hearts from the Dead Scar to brew an elixir that boosts strength against undead. Collect and return the hearts to learn the enhancement.
id:9217: Thalnos wants more ghoul hearts to reanimate more ghouls. He needs your help gathering them. Bring as many as you can find.
id:9218: A researcher needs spinal dust from Dead Scar skeletons to brew a potion that boosts magic against undead. Bring the dust to get a sample in return.
id:9219: An NPC asks for more spinal dust, needing all you can bring. They'll use whatever you supply, so gather as much as possible.
id:9220: An NPC wants you to attack the undead hordes in Deatholme, the Scourge's fortress, to challenge their power. They rebuilt the Sanctum of the Sun as a defiant stand against Deatholme's threat. Your goal is to fight the undead there to weaken the Scourge's hold.
id:9247: The Argent Dawn needs your help again. Head to Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands to speak with the Keeper of the Rolls.
id:9249: The Darkmoon Faire vendor wants 40 tickets in exchange for the Steam Tonk Controller schematic. They’ll trade tickets for prizes—just hand over the required amount to claim it.
id:9250: Atiesh's frame is almost complete but missing its staff’s head and base, which are a conduit for Sargeras’s evil. Find someone who can help retrieve the pieces and purify the staff.
id:9251: Kel'Thuzad wants the Atiesh staff you have and knows you're after it. The staff’s base stayed behind when Brann left Ahn'Qiraj. Get it and bring all the pieces to him.
id:9252: Fairbreeze villagers need help fending off Scourge attacks since Silvermoon won’t reinforce them. Kill undead in Dead Scar to reduce their numbers.
id:9253: A runewarden thinks a broken runestone in the Ghostlands is causing more Scourge attacks. Head south then west to find Runewarden Deryan near the stone and check what’s wrong.
id:9254: A former apprentice went to the East Sanctum in the Dead Scar doing dangerous research. The NPC wants you to find her and bring her back to her senses.
id:9255: The NPC needs you to deliver their research notes to Magistrix Landra Dawnstrider in Fairbreeze Village west of here, who can give them a proper review. The results aren’t credible yet without a Magister’s approval.
id:9256: Degolien is investigating a Wretched attack on a nearby shipyard and needs your help. Head to Fairbreeze Village south of Falconwing Square to assist him.
id:9257: The NPC wants you to take the corrupted staff to Stratholme and place it on holy ground where Lordaeron’s knights were killed, then defeat the demon controlling it. The staff’s power is tied to that location, so destroying the entity there will purge its corruption before you return.
id:9258: The NPC’s sister, Larianna Riverwind, is watching the Scorched Grove, where a destroyed runestone let Scourge taint spread. She might have a task for you to stop it.
id:9259: An NPC is told to turn against the Bloodsails by giving up bandannas, but refuses. The player needs to get silk cloth and red dye so the NPC can make fake bandannas instead. The Baron will think the Bloodsails turned on their captain, but this could cause trouble with the faction.
id:9260: Stormwind's being attacked by undead Scourge. Investigate runic circles outside the city, kill some creatures, and bring proof of their deaths. The runes might hold the key to stopping the invasion.
id:9261: The Lich King is sending undead near Ironforge. You need to check out the runic circles outside and kill some of the undead. Bring proof of their deaths and your findings for a reward.
id:9262: The NPC wants you to investigate glowing runic circles outside Darnassus linked to the undead and the Necropolis. Kill Scourge enemies nearby, gather their remains as proof, and report back to stop the Lich King’s advance.
id:9263: An NPC in Orgrimmar wants you to investigate runic circles linked to the Scourge invasion. Kill the undead there and bring proof to report back.
id:9264: An NPC says the Lich King’s undead are attacking Thunder Bluff and wants you to investigate glowing runic circles outside. They want you to kill undead nearby and bring proof of their deaths to help defend the area.
id:9265: The NPC wants you to investigate runic circles outside the Undercity linked to the Lich King's undead and thin out the invaders there. They need proof of the undead's deaths to secure a reward, thinking the runes hold the key to defending the city.
id:9266: A goblin in Winterspring wants you to bring runecloth and coal to improve relations, since their clan needs warmth. They warn their enemies will likely retaliate if you help.
id:9267: The NPC wants you to help treat wounded sailors who survived a Bloodsail Buccaneer attack. Bring linen cloth for bandages and empty vials for potions to prove you’re not a scoundrel.
id:9268: Goblins in Tanaris need mageweave and strong flux to build ships against Bloodsail Buccaneers. Deliver the supplies to get your trespassing pardon.
id:9269: An NPC tells you to take the corrupted Atiesh staff to Stratholme's consecrated ground, where Lordaeron's knights were slain. Place it there to face a powerful demon, defeat it, then return with the purified staff.
id:9270: The NPC tells you to take the Atiesh staff to Stratholme's consecrated ground, where Lordaeron's knights were killed. Place the staff on the holy site to battle a powerful demonic entity controlling it, then return it.
id:9271: The quest giver wants you to take the Atiesh staff to Stratholme and place it on consecrated earth where knights were killed, triggering a battle against a demon controlling the staff. Defeat the entity and return the staff.
id:9274: An NPC wants you to end the haunting of drowned ancestors at a lake to the north. The spirits are trapped due to a tragic drowning event long ago and need their suffering resolved.
id:9275: The Farstriders' borrowed expert wants to poison Shadowpine trolls by lacing their food. You'll need to eliminate the trolls at Zeb'Nowa's camp, which is split across the road to Zul'Aman.
id:9276: The NPC wants you to attack Shadowpine trolls at Zeb'Tela to weaken them before a bigger offensive. They’re low on resources and need volunteers to keep the trolls distracted. Head east and hit their camps.
id:9277: A shadowy figure sends you to attack Zeb'Nowa's Shadowpine trolls to weaken their numbers. They want you to strike hard in the south where the stronger trolls live. No fancy talk—just punch them where it hurts.
id:9278: Turn in your Collector's Edition voucher to Jaeleil in Azure Watch for a companion as a thank-you gift. She’ll reward you for purchasing the special edition.
id:9279: The NPC says the Exodar crashed, killing many, but you’re alive. They need you to lead efforts to safety. Head southwest to find Proenitus at the hill’s bottom.
id:9280: The NPC needs you to collect vale moth blood to refill depleted healing crystals. The moths are concentrated in the northwest, so head there to gather them quickly.
id:9281: Magister Kaendris' apprentice wants the area cleared of hostile wildlife to build a Scourge-fighting outpost. Kill greater spindlewebs and ghostclaw ravagers to the west and south. They'll pay you for securing the zone.
id:9282: Ranger Vynna has info on Dar'Khan. She’s at the Farstrider Enclave northeast. The player needs to talk to her to help counter him.
id:9283: A draenei survivor needs you to use your Naaru healing to save crash victims scattered west and northwest. They’re marked by a red glow from exposure to irradiated crystals. Focus on healing one injured survivor to complete the quest.
